items.titleZh: Agentic AI Automates RTL Waveform Analysis And Debugging (Columbia, Google)
items.descriptionZh:
哥伦比亚大学、Google DeepMind 与 Google 的研究人员联合发布技术论文《Back to the Future: Rethinking EDA Infrastructure for Agentic Systems in Chip Design Verification》，相关报道以“Agentic AI Automates RTL Waveform Analysis And Debugging”为题，介绍了该工作在芯片设计验证自动化方面的方向。该研究聚焦芯片验证中最耗时、最依赖人工的环节之一：RTL 波形分析与调试。

背景方面，现代人工智能的计算规模依赖包含数十亿晶体管的复杂 SoC，但验证这些芯片的工作流仍然“顽固地”以手动为主。验证工程师需要在仿真产生的大量波形中定位异常信号、回溯时序原因、构造测试并确认修复。尽管大语言模型在代码生成、自然语言理解和推理方面展现出能力，但传统 EDA 工具、数据格式和脚本接口并非为自主智能体设计，LLM 很难直接、可靠地嵌入验证闭环。因此，论文主张重新思考 EDA 基础设施，使其原生支持 agentic AI 系统。

核心技术方面，该研究提出或展示用 agentic AI 自动化 RTL 波形分析和调试。RTL 即寄存器传输级，是芯片逻辑设计的主要抽象层；仿真后生成的波形记录信号随时间变化，是调试功能错误和时序问题的关键证据。智能体系统可让 LLM 驱动多个工具和动作：读取波形与日志、理解信号语义、形成故障假设、调用 EDA 工具或脚本查询、运行定向仿真、缩小可疑范围，并给出根因或修复建议。其关键创新不是简单让 LLM 写代码，而是重构 EDA 基础设施，使工具具备机器可调用的 API、结构化状态、可组合动作和可观测反馈，从而支持“规划—执行—观察—反思”的自主调试循环。标题中的“Back to the Future”也暗示，这一思路可能借鉴早期 EDA 自动化或专家系统的目标，用现代 LLM 智能体重新实现。

性能与对比方面，从可见的论文摘要和报道片段看，尚未披露具体加速比、bug 定位准确率、波形压缩率或与人工调试的定量对比。但其预期优势明确：减少工程师在波形查看器中的手工搜索，缩短调试周期，提高验证吞吐，并让 LLM 从“辅助问答”升级为“执行验证任务”。与现有 LLM 辅助 RTL 代码生成相比，该工作更强调与 EDA 工具链深度集成和端到端任务自动化。

应用与影响方面，若该方法成熟，可用于 SoC、CPU、GPU、AI 加速器等复杂芯片的 RTL 回归测试、仿真波形调试、覆盖率收敛和 bug 根因分析。它还可能推动 EDA 工具设计范式从 GUI/脚本为中心转向 agent-ready，对 Synopsys、Cadence、Siemens EDA 等厂商及自研芯片团队均有启示。同时，幻觉、可解释性、安全性、数据隐私和与现有流程的兼容性仍是落地挑战。总体而言，这项工作代表 LLM/智能体进入芯片验证关键环节的重要方向：重点不只是模型能力，而是为智能体重建 EDA 基础设施，使 RTL 波形分析与调试真正自动化。

items.content: More AI agents will soon be able to browse and purchase from Shopify listings, marking an expansion of the company’s agentic commerce ambitions.Shopify announced Tuesday it will let shoppers configure their AI agents to purchase products on their behalf, giving more agents access to over a billion listings in Shopify’s catalog. (The catalog consists of both items on and off Shopify storefronts.) In September, Shopify announced it was partnering with Meta to allow its Muse agent to browse and purchase items on a human’s behalf; now, shoppers can use any agent without a partnership integration.To set up the feature, customers connect an agent with their account on Shop, a Shopify-owned platform that consolidates orders, tracks packages, and recommends products. Like the Muse partnership, customers use the one-click Shop Pay feature to check out within the conversation with the agent. Orders placed through the agent are funneled back to the Shop app. Shopify is marketing the feature as a “personal shopper” that humans can give rules to, like setting budget guardrails or only displaying products with fast shipping. Buyers must approve each purchase.E-commerce has become one of the battlegrounds in the era of AI — it’s no coincidence that many demos of agentic tools end with a transaction, whether it’s buying clothing, booking a flight, or ordering takeout on a human’s behalf. The tech industry, including big commerce players like Google and Amazon, are investing in AI-driven shopping tools where the end goal is an “agent” purchasing things for a human user. It’s also the basis of an ongoing fight between Amazon and AI companies like Perplexity — and more recently, Meta’s Muse — over whether agents should be able to shop on a customer’s behalf.

items.titleZh: Shopify向更多AI代理开放其商品目录
items.descriptionZh:
Shopify 周二宣布，将允许购物者配置自己的 AI 代理代其购买商品，使更多代理能够访问 Shopify 目录中超过 10 亿条商品列表。该目录包括在 Shopify 店面内和不在 Shopify 店面内的商品。这标志着 Shopify 代理式商务（agentic commerce）野心进一步扩大。此前在 9 月，Shopify 与 Meta 合作，允许 Meta 的 Muse 代理代表人类浏览和购买商品；现在，购物者可以使用任何代理，而无需 Shopify 与代理方进行合作集成。

在运作机制上，用户需要先把代理与自己的 Shop 账户连接。Shop 是 Shopify 拥有的平台，用于整合订单、跟踪包裹和推荐商品。与 Muse 合作时类似，顾客可在与代理的对话中使用一键 Shop Pay 结账。通过代理下的订单会回流到 Shop 应用。Shopify 将该功能营销为“个人购物者”，用户可以给它设定规则，例如预算护栏，或只显示配送快的商品。每笔购买必须由买家批准。

创新点主要在开放集成和基础设施复用，而非新的 AI 模型：Shopify 把代理接入其账户、支付和订单体系。此前代理购物需要专门合作，现在变成“任意代理 + Shop 账户 + Shop Pay + Shop 订单回流”的通用路径。这降低了代理购物的集成门槛，也让代理成为商品发现和交易入口。不过，原文未披露底层 API、身份验证、支付令牌化、安全审计等技术细节。

从对比数据看，原文给出的量化信息包括：覆盖 Shopify 目录超过 10 亿条商品；从仅支持 Meta Muse 扩展到支持任意代理；从需要合作集成变为无需合作集成。除此之外，没有提供响应延迟、支付成功率、购买转化率、支持代理数量、准确率等性能指标，因此无法进行更细的性能对比。

背景是，电商已成为 AI 时代的重要战场。许多代理工具演示最终都落在交易上，例如买衣服、订航班或替人点外卖。包括 Google、Amazon 在内的科技和商业巨头都在投资 AI 驱动购物工具，目标是让“代理”替用户购买。这也是 Amazon 与 Perplexity、以及近期 Meta 的 Muse 等 AI 公司持续争论的焦点：代理是否应被允许代表客户购物。

应用场景包括个人购物代理、预算受控消费、快速配送筛选、对话内结账和订单集中管理。对 Shopify 商家而言，可能获得来自代理的新流量；对消费者而言，便利性提升但需授权每笔购买。更广泛影响是，电商入口可能从人类浏览转向代理中介，平台需要重新处理代理身份、支付授权、订单归因和商家曝光，同时与 Amazon 等平台围绕代理能否代购的政策冲突也可能加剧。

items.content: After months sitting on the sidelines of the frontier AI race, Google has finally launched its long-awaited Gemini 4 Argon model, claiming it can compete with the best the industry has to offer.Google says Argon delivers “frontier reasoning and improved performance across complex workflows,” while cutting down on hedging, repetition, and the cliches that continue to plague AI chatbots. The company claims Argon outperforms rival models like GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5.5 across a range of benchmarks, including coding, cybersecurity, science, finance, and law.Google says it’s already putting Argon to use internally, such as finding and patching cybersecurity vulnerabilities, halving the computing power needed to power YouTube’s comments section, and debugging the drone physics simulator for Alphabet’s drone delivery company Wing.The model is rolling out today to Google’s higher-tier Pro and Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app and AI mode in Search, as well to Ultra subscribers on its agentic development platform Antigravity. It is not clear when — or if — Argon will be available to Plus subscribers or free users.Google is pricing Argon very competitively. The model is launching with an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, around a fifth the cost of OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and Anthropic’s Fable 5 models. Even after those costs double at the end November — when the introductory period finishes — Argon will still be significantly cheaper than its frontier rivals on a per-token basis, though this doesn’t necessarily translate to lower costs in practice, as models can use different numbers of tokens for the same tasks.The launch fills in some of the blanks left behind from when Google first teased Argon a few weeks ago. In line with other recent frontier model releases, the public rollout follows a limited release to a select set of “trusted cyber defenders” to be tested for potential risks.Argon is Google’s first major frontier release since Gemini 3 in late 2025. In the intervening months, impressive models from Anthropic and OpenAI have seen Google trail far behind its rivals. Seismic internal shakeups raised further doubts about the company’s ability — or desire — to reclaim its position and compete at the frontier of AI.But Argon’s arrival suggests we can’t count Google out of the AI race just yet. Landing just a day after Meta announced its own frontier model, Muse Wonder Full, Argon is a reminder of how quickly the balance of power can shift in AI, and that the frontier is far from a two-horse race.
items.author: Robert Hart
items.descriptionZh:
Google 在旁观前沿 AI 竞赛数月后，正式发布期待已久的 Gemini 4 Argon，并宣称其能够与业界最强模型竞争。Google 表示，Argon 提供“前沿推理”和“跨复杂工作流的性能改进”，同时减少 AI 聊天机器人常见的模棱两可/回避性表述、重复和套话。公司声称，Argon 在编码、网络安全、科学、金融和法律等一系列基准测试中，优于 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Opus 5.5 等竞品。不过，Google 并未披露 Argon 的具体架构、训练方法、上下文窗口、延迟、吞吐或各基准的具体得分，因此其“前沿推理”背后的技术机制尚不明确；公开可见的创新点主要集中在模型行为与输出质量优化，即降低 hedging、重复和陈词滥调，使复杂任务中的回答更直接、更可用。

从背景看，Argon 是 Google 自 2025 年末 Gemini 3 以来首个重大前沿模型发布。在这期间，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 推出了多款表现强劲的模型，Google 被认为明显落后于竞争对手；同时，公司内部剧烈震荡进一步引发外界对其能否或是否愿意重返前沿 AI 地位的怀疑。几周前，Google 首次预热 Argon，并遵循近期前沿模型发布的常见做法，先向一组“受信任的网络防御者”有限开放，以测试潜在风险。此次公开发布紧随 Meta 宣布其前沿模型 Muse Wonder Full 的一天后，显示 AI 领域的权力平衡可以迅速变化，前沿竞争也远非两强竞赛。

在性能和定价方面，Google 对 Argon 采取了极具竞争力的策略。该模型以介绍期价格推出：每百万输入 token 2 美元，每百万输出 token 10 美元，约为 OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 和 Anthropic Fable 5 模型的五分之一。即使 11 月底介绍期结束、价格翻倍，按每 token 计算，Argon 仍将显著低于这些前沿竞品。但需要注意，每 token 单价更低并不必然意味着实际任务总成本更低，因为不同模型完成同一任务时消耗的 token 数量可能不同。Google 目前也未提供与竞品对比的具体效率数据或基准分数，仅给出领先声明和内部用例。

可用性方面，Argon 今天起向 Google 更高阶的 Pro 和 Ultra 订阅者推出，覆盖 Gemini 应用和 Search 中的 AI 模式；同时也向智能体开发平台 Antigravity 的 Ultra 订阅者开放。目前尚不清楚 Argon 何时或是否会向 Plus 订阅者或免费用户提供。Google 表示，公司已在内部使用 Argon，包括发现并修补网络安全漏洞、将 YouTube 评论区的算力需求减半，以及为 Alphabet 旗下无人机配送公司 Wing 调试无人机物理模拟器。这些用例表明，Argon 的目标场景不仅是聊天，还包括网络安全、基础设施优化、科学/工程仿真和智能体开发。

总体而言，Argon 的发布填补了几周前预热留下的空白，并表明 Google 仍未退出前沿 AI 竞赛。它紧随 Meta 的发布，提醒业界前沿格局可能快速多极化，而非 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的双强游戏。对 Google 而言，Argon 是重新证明前沿竞争力的关键一步；对市场而言，其激进定价可能给竞争对手带来价格压力，并推动企业重新评估模型选型。但 Argon 的实际能力、可靠性和总拥有成本，仍需独立评测以及更广泛开放后进一步验证。

items.titleZh: 据报道，中国人工智能公司一年内购买100万块英伟达GPU
items.descriptionZh:
据《金融时报》报道，中国科技公司已购买超过 100 万颗 NVIDIA 游戏与工作站 GPU，用于填补 AI 算力需求缺口。这一采购潮发生在国产 AI 芯片产量快速扩张的背景下：中国将 AI 列为国家战略，推动本土 AI 芯片产量今年翻倍，但仍无法满足最大科技公司的需求。报道援引业内人士称，中国国内预计只能制造约 350 万颗 AI 芯片，而需求“远超”500 万颗，缺口接近 150 万颗。因此，中国企业转向符合美国出口管制的 NVIDIA 游戏和工作站处理器，并将其重新用于 AI 工作负载。

从技术路径看，这些芯片主要是 NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000D、RTX Pro 5000 和 RTX 5090，均属于 Blackwell 架构。它们无法与华为 Ascend 910C 等国产旗舰 AI 芯片正面竞争，但适合“较简单的 AI 工作负载”，例如推理中的预填充阶段。预填充是 LLM 推理的第一阶段：系统把用户输入的整段提示词并行编码，生成注意力 KV 缓存，计算密度高、并行度大，适合 GPU 吞吐；后续解码阶段逐 token 生成，更受显存带宽和延迟限制。消费级/工作站 GPU 虽缺少数据中心 GPU 的 HBM 高带宽内存和 NVLink/NVSwitch 高速互联，多卡扩展效率不如 H100/H200 等产品，但其 Tensor Core、GDDR 显存和 CUDA 生态仍能承担部分推理任务。尤其 CUDA 软件栈比华为 CANN 替代方案更成熟、开发者支持更广，这是中国企业继续采购 NVIDIA 硬件的重要原因。

性能与市场数据也凸显了供需失衡。RTX 5090 官方建议零售价为 1,999 美元，但目前只能在少数第三方经销商处找到，价格不低于 7,199 美元，溢价超过 260%，并且几乎从常规市场消失。报道还指出，NVIDIA 已停止 RTX 5090 生产，计划由 24GB 显存的 RTX 5080 旗舰型号取代；相比当前 32GB 显存的 RTX 5090，这是一次明显降级，对发烧友市场而言是消极信号，说明消费级 GPU 市场正被 AI 需求持续挤压。

这一现象的技术影响和产业含义是多方面的。首先，它表明美国出口管制虽然限制了中国获取最先进数据中心 GPU，但合规的游戏/工作站 GPU 仍可被重新部署到 AI 推理等场景，形成“合规硬件 + CUDA 生态”的算力补足策略。其次，国产 AI 芯片虽然产量翻倍，且华为 Ascend 910C 等产品在部分指标上具备竞争力，但软件生态、集群互联和开发者迁移成本仍是短板，导致中国大型科技公司仍严重依赖 NVIDIA 硬件。相关报道还显示，H200 已按逐案进口许可进入中国，但对 NVIDIA 而言可能为时已晚；同时，中国 AI 加速器供应商 Biren 营收同比增长 2000%，说明本土替代需求也在爆发。总体来看，中国 AI 算力市场正形成“国产芯片扩产 + 合规 NVIDIA GPU 补缺 + CUDA 生态锁定”的混合格局，而消费级 GPU 价格飙升和 RTX 5090 停产降级，则反映出 AI 算力争夺正在深刻重塑整个 GPU 市场。

items.title: Anthropic warns of self-replicating AI worm threat that doesn't need data centers to self-improve and spread
items.description: Anthropic’s paper establishes conceptual model capabilities, but doesn’t quite demonstrate a real threat until models improve further.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 12 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Anthropic's Frontier Red Team has demonstrated two components of a potential AI-powered worm that, if key issues with the practical implementation are resolved, could spread across consumer devices including inexpensive Android TV boxes and smart appliances, hypothetically without relying on datacenter infrastructure. The experiments show that AI agents can configure inference across different hardware platforms and orchestrate replication across a network. There are still some serious limitations, though, particularly around the gap between the capabilities of today's models versus the hardware constraints of potential targets.In its October 12 report, titled "AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter," Anthropic examines a potential class of malware called a weight-based replicator. Rather than distributing conventional executable code, it would propagate AI model weights alongside the software infrastructure needed to run inference on compromised devices, and it's not pure theory, either.The researchers demonstrated that Qwen3.5-9B can establish an inference server on eight of nine tested hardware types, spanning NVIDIA Jetson Nano devices, Apple Silicon Macs, Xeon servers, a Google TPU, AMD's MI300X, and at least one PC with an RTX 4090, among others. They also ran Gemma4-26B-A4B across 15 off-brand Android TV boxes costing approximately $55 each, achieving a combined generation rate of 0.39 tokens per second.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Anthropic also tested whether a model could orchestrate replication across a network. The experiment used eight Google Cloud nodes running Android 15 emulators. A seeded agent propagated between nodes through an unauthenticated Android Debug Bridge (ADB) port, transferring files and establishing an inference server on each target. GLM-5.2, a titanic model with 744 billion parameters over 1TB in size, completed the replication sequence across all eight nodes in four of five trials, reaching seven nodes in the remaining trial. (Image credit: Anthropic)No other tested open-weight model was able to complete the sequence at all without orchestration from GLM-5.2, and they weren't able to meaningfully ask a larger model for help, either, despite being equipped with the capability. Naturally, GLM-5.2 wasn't actually replicating itself onto smart TV boxes; instead, it established an inference server for the much smaller Llama 3.1 8B on each target. GLM-5.2 ran on a separate inference server because the emulated nodes couldn't handle the larger model. You may like Anthropic CEO warns of AI-driven botnet 'swarm' taking over the entire internet Anthropic claims popular Chinese AI model has Mythos-class hacking abilities AI leaders clash over safety fears after Anthropic whistleblower says AI could 'kill us all' by 2030 In other words, Anthropic demonstrated that a very large, externally hosted model can orchestrate a simplified replication sequence across machines with deliberately exposed ADB interfaces, and it showed that small models can set up inference, but it absolutely hasn't proven that a small model can independently replicate itself across consumer hardware. That distinction, admittedly fine, is nevertheless pretty important when the entire premise is that small models could soon spread without relying on datacenter infrastructure.The experiments expose a central constraint of the research: models capable of reliably completing the replication sequence aren't currently small enough to run on inexpensive target devices, while models that fit within those devices' memory budgets, despite being capable of setting up inference, still can't reliably complete the entire process. This gap between the intelligence needed for reliable replication and the maximum model size that target hardware can support means that this threat model isn't really applicable right now, but Anthropic warns that gap could narrow, and potentially soon.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors (Image credit: Anthropic)Using historical improvements in general AI capability (measured through the Epoch Capabilities Index), Anthropic projects that a model within the 30-billion-parameter class could reach the necessary capability level by the end of 2026. But once again, that's a hypothetical, and it still doesn't address the substantial efficiency problem.Based on measured inference performance and the token requirements of its setup experiments, Anthropic estimates that establishing an inference environment would take approximately 28–51 hours for Qwen3.5-9B and 71–150 hours for Gemma4-26B-A4B at the observed throughput of its cheap Android TV boxes, and it’s worth noting that the boxes it used are configurations with 4GB of RAM, a relative luxury among these cheap set-top boxes. A model-driven replicator could take days to establish an inference environment on a new host, whereas conventional malware can execute its payload within seconds when its assumptions about the target hold. A conventional worm can spread to tens of thousands of vulnerable targets in minutes.Model weights also impose substantial bandwidth and storage costs. Anthropic acknowledges that compromised hosts could download weights from external repositories rather than receiving them directly from an infected device, and that not every compromised machine would need to host a model. Nevertheless, distributing multi-gigabyte payloads and maintaining communication between machines running a sharded model would generate tremendous network traffic, making the activity very easy to detect. What to read next OpenAI's HuggingFace breach heralds an unprecedented age of AI cyber warfare OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and unreleased AI models break out of testing environment in 'unprecedented cybersecurity incident' Top AI labs reportedly planning for catastrophic AI event fallout Anthropic estimates that a hypothetical fleet comparable in size to the infamous Kimwolf botnet, which infected more than two million devices at its peak, could support approximately 133,000 instances of Gemma4-26B-A4B if every 15 devices collectively hosted one model. At the measured throughput (which benefits considerably from LAN latency), Anthropic says that such a fleet would provide roughly 40 Hopper H100-equivalents of inference capacity.This is a very messy comparison that takes significant liberties with the data, but even at that it must be said that it's not particularly intimidating. We're talking about two million infected devices that must remain infected and operable for months (or years; infecting 2 million devices would take around 6,300 agent-years even with the fastest 28-hour stand-up speed) to produce less AI inference throughput than a few blades of previous-generation GPUs.Anthropic notes that a real replicator could exploit other types of hardware, deploy different models across heterogeneous devices, and avoid loading model weights onto every compromised host. Those possibilities certainly complicate the comparison, but arguably they complicate it beyond the bounds of this discussion. (Image credit: Anthropic)The research does identify a meaningful security concern: AI agents could make malware more adaptable to unfamiliar environments and reduce the amount of target-specific engineering required. A hybrid approach, combining conventional code for routine operations with AI-driven reasoning when unexpected conditions arise, could offer some of those benefits without requiring every compromised device to run an inference engine continuously. This is definitely concerning, but we've already seen AI agents using frontier intelligence write their own code to compromise secured systems, so that specific angle on this research isn't exactly groundbreaking.Anthropic's experiments are useful in that they provide evidence that autonomous software configuration and simplified network replication are increasingly feasible, but turning those capabilities into a materially more dangerous class of malware will take improvements in model reliability, hardware compatibility, deployment efficiency, and the ability to overcome real-world security controls, which the firm didn’t test. There’s a ton of data and some interesting findings not discussed here in the actual paper, so if you’re interested in the research you should go check it out. items.titleZh: Anthropic警告：无需数据中心即可自我改进和传播的自我复制AI蠕虫威胁
items.descriptionZh:
Anthropic 的 Frontier Red Team 在 10 月 12 日发布的报告《AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter》中，演示了一种潜在 AI 驱动蠕虫的两个关键组件：跨异构硬件自动配置推理，以及跨网络编排复制。如果实际部署中的关键问题被解决，这类恶意软件理论上可绕过数据中心基础设施，在廉价 Android TV 盒子、智能家电等消费设备之间传播。但报告同时强调，当前实验仍存在严重限制，尤其是模型能力与目标硬件约束之间的巨大鸿沟。

报告提出了一类被称为“基于权重的复制器”（weight-based replicator）的恶意软件。它不传播传统可执行代码，而是把 AI 模型权重以及运行推理所需的软件基础设施一起传播到被感染设备上。这并非纯理论：研究人员让 Qwen3.5-9B 在 9 种测试硬件中的 8 种上成功建立推理服务器，覆盖 NVIDIA Jetson Nano、Apple Silicon Mac、Xeon 服务器、Google TPU、AMD MI300X，以及至少一台配备 RTX 4090 的 PC 等。他们还让 Gemma4-26B-A4B 在 15 台杂牌 Android TV 盒子上运行，这些盒子每台约 55 美元，合计生成速率仅为 0.39 tokens/s。

Anthropic 还测试了模型能否跨网络编排复制。实验使用 8 个运行 Android 15 模拟器的 Google Cloud 节点。一个“种子”智能体通过未认证的 Android 调试桥（ADB）端口在节点间传播，传输文件并在每个目标上建立推理服务器。拥有 7440 亿参数、体积超过 1TB 的巨型模型 GLM-5.2，在 5 次试验中有 4 次完成了全部 8 个节点的复制序列，剩余一次达到 7 个节点。其他被测开放权重模型如果没有 GLM-5.2 的编排，完全无法完成该序列，也无法有效向更大模型求助，尽管它们被赋予了这种能力。需要澄清的是，GLM-5.2 并未真正把自己复制到智能电视盒子上；它在每个目标上为小得多的 Llama 3.1 8B 建立推理服务器。GLM-5.2 本身运行在单独的推理服务器上，因为模拟节点无法承受这个大模型。

换言之，Anthropic 证明的是一个非常大的、外部托管的模型，可以在故意暴露 ADB 接口的机器之间编排简化的复制流程；也证明小模型可以建立推理环境。但它没有证明小模型能够独立地在消费级硬件上自我复制。这个区别看似微妙，却非常重要，因为整个威胁前提是“小模型可能很快在不依赖数据中心的情况下传播”。

实验暴露的核心矛盾是：能够可靠完成复制序列的模型，目前还不够小，无法在廉价目标设备上运行；而能塞进这些设备内存预算的模型，虽然可以建立推理，却仍无法可靠完成整个复制过程。可靠复制所需的智能水平与目标硬件支持的最大模型规模之间的差距，意味着这一威胁模型目前并不现实。但 Anthropic 警告，这一差距可能缩小，而且可能很快。基于 Epoch Capabilities Index 衡量的通用 AI 能力历史改进，Anthropic 预测 300 亿参数级别的模型可能在 2026 年底达到必要能力水平。但这仍是假设，且没有解决严重的效率问题。

根据实测推理性能和设置实验所需 token，Anthropic 估计，在廉价 Android TV 盒子的吞吐量下，Qwen3.5-9B 建立推理环境需要约 28–51 小时，Gemma4-26B-A4B 需要约 71–150 小时。值得注意的是，实验使用的盒子还是 4GB RAM 配置，在这类廉价机顶盒中已算相对奢侈。模型驱动的复制器可能需要数天才能在新主机上建立推理环境，而传统恶意软件在目标假设成立时可在数秒内执行载荷，传统蠕虫可在几分钟内传播到数万个脆弱目标。

模型权重还带来巨大的带宽和存储成本。Anthropic 承认，被感染主机可以从外部仓库下载权重，而不必直接从感染设备接收；也不是每台被感染机器都需要托管模型。然而，分发数 GB 级载荷，并维持运行分片模型的多台机器之间通信，会产生巨大网络流量，使活动非常容易被检测。

Anthropic 还估算，如果一支僵尸网络规模与臭名昭著的 Kimwolf 相当——后者峰值感染超过 200 万台设备——并且每 15 台设备集体托管一个模型，那么可支持约 133,000 个 Gemma4-26B-A4B 实例。按实测吞吐（显著受益于局域网延迟），这样一支舰队可提供约 40 个 Hopper H100 等效的推理容量。文章认为，这一比较非常粗糙，对数据做了很大自由发挥，但即便如此也谈不上特别可怕：200 万台被感染设备必须保持感染和可操作数月甚至数年，即使按最快的 28 小时部署速度，感染 200 万台也需要约 6,300 智能体年，最终产生的 AI 推理吞吐却少于几片上一代 GPU。

Anthropic 指出，真正的复制器可能利用其他类型硬件、在异构设备上部署不同模型，并避免把模型权重加载到每台被感染主机。这些可能性会让比较更复杂，但可能已超出讨论范围。研究确实识别出一个有意义的安全担忧：AI 智能体可使恶意软件更适应陌生环境，并减少针对特定目标所需的工程。混合方法——用常规代码处理日常操作，在意外条件出现时引入 AI 驱动推理——可能获得部分优势，而无需每台被感染设备持续运行推理引擎。这当然值得警惕，但此前已出现 AI 智能体利用前沿智能编写代码攻破安全系统，因此这一角度本身并非全新突破。

总体而言，Anthropic 的实验提供了有用证据：自主软件配置和简化网络复制正变得越来越可行。但要把这些能力转化为真正更危险的恶意软件，还需要在模型可靠性、硬件兼容性、部署效率以及克服现实世界安全控制方面取得改进，而这些是该公司并未测试的。论文中还有大量数据和有趣发现未在上述讨论中展开。当前威胁模型并不适用，但 Anthropic 警告，能力与硬件之间的差距可能收窄，安全界应持续关注。

items.content: When Nvidia originally showed off DLSS 5 earlier this year, the technology immediately got branded as gen AI for video games. To gamers, Nvidia had lost the plot. I personally couldn’t get over how faces were transformed using DLSS 5. The 15-year-old student from Hogwarts Legacy suddenly looked much older, and Grace from Resident Evil Requiem looked yassified.Now more than six months later, DLSS 5 is about to debut properly in Hogwarts Legacy, and it looks like it has been seriously toned down. Nvidia published new comparison screenshots today, where the changes to faces are as subtle as they are in NBA 2K27. Teenagers no longer look like middle-aged men, and even the environmental changes look more subtle.Nvidia’s DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy in March.Nvidia’s new Hogwarts Legacy DLSS 5 comparisons.Nvidia has always maintained that developers have “detailed artistic control” over DLSS 5, and ultimately make the choice on how to implement the technology in their own games. DLSS 5 will now appear in Hogwarts Legacy on November 5th, and it’s also coming to Where Winds Meet late next month.Nvidia is also improving the performance hit of DLSS 5 with an October update to the neural rendering system that should make it twice as fast on RTX 50-series GPUs and the upcoming RTX Spark laptops. “The DLSS 5 October update shrinks the footprint by 24 percent to roughly 118 million parameters while reducing 4K VRAM usage by 20 percent,” says Nvidia’s Andrew Burnes. This new DLSS 5 model will debut first in NBA 2K27 on October 16th and “will ship by default with future DLSS 5 games.”Alongside the DLSS 5 updates, Nvidia has also shipped a new Nvidia app beta update that includes a faster performance mode for Frame Generation on RTX 40- and 50-series GPUs. The updated AI model uses a “faster and lighter algorithm to boost frame rates” for Frame Gen, Multi Frame Gen, and Dynamic Multi Frame Gen. Nvidia says it has “minor trade-offs in image quality,” and that performance mode for Frame Generation should now be up to 35 precent faster.

items.titleZh: DLSS 5在《霍格沃茨之遗》下月首发中遭降级
items.descriptionZh:
今年早些时候英伟达首次展示DLSS 5时，该技术立即被贴上“游戏生成式AI”的标签，许多玩家认为英伟达偏离了方向。当时DLSS 5对面部的改变尤其引发争议：《霍格沃茨之遗》中15岁的学生看起来像中年男子，《生化危机：安魂曲》中的Grace则被过度美颜化。六个月后，DLSS 5即将在《霍格沃茨之遗》中正式上线，而效果已明显收敛。英伟达发布的新对比截图显示，面部变化已像NBA 2K27中那样微妙，青少年不再显老，环境变化也更加自然。英伟达一直强调，开发者对DLSS 5拥有“详细的艺术控制”，并最终决定如何在自家游戏中实现该技术。DLSS 5将于11月5日登陆《霍格沃茨之遗》，并将在下个月晚些时候登陆《燕云十六声》（Where Winds Meet）。

技术层面，DLSS 5是一套神经渲染系统。英伟达通过10月更新改善了其性能开销，使其在RTX 50系列GPU和即将推出的RTX Spark笔记本上速度提升一倍。英伟达的Andrew Burnes表示：“DLSS 5十月更新将模型占用缩小24%，降至约1.18亿参数，同时将4K分辨率下的显存使用减少20%。”这一新DLSS 5模型将于10月16日随NBA 2K27首次亮相，并“将默认随未来DLSS 5游戏发布”。这意味着更小、更高效的AI模型有望降低DLSS 5的硬件门槛和性能影响。

除DLSS 5更新外，英伟达还发布了新版Nvidia app测试版，为RTX 40和50系列GPU的帧生成引入更快的性能模式。更新后的AI模型采用“更快、更轻的算法来提升帧率”，覆盖Frame Gen、Multi Frame Gen和Dynamic Multi Frame Gen。英伟达承认该模式在图像质量上有“轻微妥协”，但帧生成的性能模式现在最高可提升35%。整体来看，英伟达正在通过模型压缩、算法优化和开发者控制，让生成式AI在游戏中的应用从最初争议性的“过度生成”转向更可控、更高效、更贴近艺术意图的实用阶段。

items.title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
items.description: NVIDIA RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — a reinvention combining the capabilities of a gaming PC, a creative studio and a personal AI supercomputer into a single superchip. With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and […]
items.content: NVIDIA RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — a reinvention combining the capabilities of a gaming PC, a creative studio and a personal AI supercomputer into a single superchip. With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and CUDA technologies for creators, developers and gamers, while unlocking a new paradigm in personal computing via powerful local AI agents. Last week, NVIDIA and Microsoft announced that RTX Spark laptops will be available on Friday, Oct. 16. Ahead of the launch, NVIDIA and its ecosystem partners are rolling out new software features and performance optimizations to expand what’s possible with local AI on RTX Spark. New and upcoming RTX Spark updates — among the thousands of apps, games and models available at launch — include: New agent features, models and tools that enhance local agents on RTX Spark: Updates to top agent apps including GitHub Copilot, Hermes, OpenClaw, Perplexity, Pi and WorkBuddy streamline setup on RTX Spark, improve security with OpenShell and Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC), and enable hybrid local and cloud AI routing. The NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B model, purpose-built for agentic AI on RTX Spark, releases on Thursday, Oct. 15. NVIDIA PAIR moves out of beta and adds llama.cpp support. Top creative apps optimized for RTX Spark: Up to 2x performance is coming soon to Adobe’s top apps. NVIDIA and Adobe have collaborated to rearchitect Photoshop for GPU-accelerated compositing and Premiere for playback, rendering, effects and more. The NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 release brings new Video Super Resolution, Video Frame Generation, offline file processing and agent Model Context Protocol (MCP) controls to the app. NVIDIA RTX Video Frame Generation and high dynamic range (HDR) capabilities are available now in ComfyUI to accelerate AI generative video workflows. NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction will be available in Blender 5.3 in November to improve interactivity in the viewport. Developer tools are now ready for RTX Spark: Top developer frameworks are now available for RTX Spark, including PyTorch, Python and CUDA, as well as all CUDA libraries. GitHub Copilot, Pi and other coding agents are now optimized for RTX Spark. Llama.cpp adds support for decision models, and releases a Windows app. Hundreds of top games and anti-cheat are supported on RTX Spark, plus: A 2x faster DLSS 5 AI model arrives Friday, Oct. 16, and a new Performance Mode for DLSS Frame Generation is available today via the NVIDIA App beta. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, the third-generation small language model (SLM) for NVIDIA ACE AI game characters, releases Friday, Oct. 23. The latest RTX Remix update, including DLSS 5 support, releases on Friday, Oct. 23. Advancing Local AI Agents With New Apps, Models and Tools AI is changing the way people interact with PCs. Agent popularity skyrocketed this year, with projects such as OpenClaw and Hermes topping popularity charts on GitHub. Local large language models (LLMs) surpassed the intelligence threshold to power agents, with models like Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next catching up to frontier cloud models released just a few months ago. As a result, local LLM downloads are already 5x higher than all of last year. From models to agent harnesses to security to tools, NVIDIA is partnering closely with the local AI ecosystem to make RTX Spark the ideal hardware to run local agents. Local AI Agents Made Easy On RTX Spark From the first boot of RTX Spark, users will be greeted with a “Getting Started” screen to choose and install their agent app. These agents will come with new, secure sandboxing technology thanks to NVIDIA OpenShell and MXC. MXC delivers operating system-level security, while OpenShell makes it simpler for agents to adopt MXC and adds advanced capabilities such as credential protection and security monitoring. Hermes Agent will integrate granular OpenShell controls and MXC by the end of the month. OpenClaw and GitHub Copilot now support MXC. After installing an agent, setting up local AI is also now seamless in GitHub Copilot, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Perplexity, Pi and WorkBuddy. The apps will recommend an optimized local model and settings configuration for RTX Spark, and set it all up for users in a few clicks. Many users want the best of both worlds — local models for free iteration, and cloud models for frontier intelligence. NVIDIA Switchyard, an open source model router library, enables agents to intelligently route queries between local and cloud LLMs, allowing the user to minimize cloud usage but still obtain similar results to just running on cloud. Hermes will be adding Switchyard later in October, and other agents like Perplexity Computer and GitHub Copilot have integrated their own routing solutions. Software providers have made it simple for agents to connect to top Windows apps, with easy-to-use MCP libraries and command line interfaces (CLIs). NVIDIA has also now made available MCPs for its applications, including NVIDIA App, Broadcast, PAIR, Omniverse, RTX Remix and a large library of CUDA-X Skills. NVIDIA is also releasing AI playbooks for RTX Spark, available on Friday, Oct 16. Users can set up their first agent, build an AI chief of staff, configure their system for development or design a creative assistant. Meet Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B: Built for Local Agents on RTX Spark NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, available Thursday, Oct. 15, is a new LLM purpose-built for running local agents on RTX Spark. This model is a 74B parameter, 9B-active-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, packed into 24GB using 2-bit quantization with advanced quantization-aware training techniques to retain quality. It aims to achieve the optimal balance between speed and intelligence, being faster than most popular dense models while smarter than most popular MoE models with a similar memory footprint. Users will be able to run Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B at launch through llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, Unsloth and LM Studio. It will also be directly accessible via agents such as Hermes and OpenClaw. Like other Nemotron models, Bolt 74B is fully open source — including training data, weights and recipes — so developers can fine-tune and customize their own agents. The Perfect PAIR Local AI doesn’t have to run on just one PC. NVIDIA PAIR, a personal AI router, is officially moving out of beta today, making it easier to tap into the total AI compute of compatible PCs on a local network. The free, open source software tool automatically discovers and connects devices, installs AI models and inference engines, and distributes AI workloads across available systems. The official release adds llama.cpp support, direct model downloads from Hugging Face, customizable inference engine settings and RTX Spark support, along with a variety of inference and user experience improvements. PAIR works on Windows, Linux and macOS. Developers can contribute to the open source project via Github — just one month after the initial PAIR release, the community has already contributed over 10 features and fixes to the release. Sparking Creativity RTX Spark brings over 130 accelerated apps, CUDA for fast video and image generation, and RTX technologies such as DLSS, NVENC and OptiX to advanced content creation workflows — all in a thin and light laptop with on-the-go performance. Adobe Accelerates Creative Applications for RTX Spark Adobe is optimizing its industry-leading creative applications, including Photoshop, Premiere and Substance 3D, for RTX Spark, delivering up to 2x faster AI, editing, color and effects across creative workflows. In Photoshop, GPU-accelerated compositing makes complex image editing faster and more responsive, with improvements to the Remove Tool and effects such as Light Leaks. Premiere accelerates demanding video editing tasks, including playback, rendering, color grading and AI-powered features such as Enhance Speech and Object Mask. Meanwhile, Substance 3D Painter speeds up texture creation workflows, from baking high-resolution mesh maps to opening, saving and exporting large projects. The updates will be rolling out in phases, with AI feature optimizations in Photoshop and Premiere now ready in beta, and with Adobe Substance 3D updates coming soon. Opt in to the beta to get access to the RTX Spark-optimized builds. Latest NVIDIA Broadcast Brings New AI Effects to Live and Recorded Content Available for download now, NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 runs natively on RTX Spark, and adds new RTX Video Super Resolution and Frame Generation AI effects and Studio Voice profiles. A new Offline File Processor lets creators apply Broadcast effects to prerecorded content, with many effects running at higher quality since there isn’t a need to maintain real-time performance. The update also introduces a new MCP server and skill that lets local AI agents adjust effects, change settings and process files directly through the Broadcast app. RTX Video Brings Frame Generation and HDR to ComfyUI ComfyUI is expanding its RTX Video tools with two new nodes: RTX Video Frame Generation and RTX Video HDR. It’s also providing the ability to export EXR files, giving creators more ways to enhance AI-generated video. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/comfyui_nvidia_vfx_nodes_explainer_4k48_v4.mp4 RTX Video Frame Generation increases video frame rates for smoother motion for GeForce RTX 40 Series GPUs and newer, while RTX Video HDR converts standard dynamic range (SDR) footage to HDR for greater flexibility in color grading. Combined with RTX Video Super Resolution, these tools enable creators to upscale, enhance and refine video within a single ComfyUI workflow. For example, creators can combine LTX 2.5 with RTX Video Frame Generation and HDR to transform a 1080p, 30 frames-per-second (fps) SDR clip into a smoother 60 fps HDR video exported as EXR files ready for color grading. Blender Adds DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction Blender has released a beta version of its popular 3D editor, adding compatibility for RTX Spark. Download Blender version 5.3 to get access. Coming next month, Blender will also be adding support for DLSS Ray Reconstruction, allowing for real-time updates in the viewport so artists can navigate a scene while previewing it in real time. Code, Text and Deploy From RTX Spark Developers are moving from writing code to directing AI agents. This new development paradigm is requiring many to spread their work across their laptop, a cloud LLM and a cloud virtual machine, where they test and prototype. RTX Spark enables developers to work on one machine, running all their workloads and libraries, testing and prototyping, and deploying. They can now do so directly in Windows with the new Windows Developer Config, which enhances the user experience for devs and installs all the top developer tools — or via Windows Subsystem for Linux, where they can get access to the same packages they’ll use to publish to the cloud. Developer Tools Are RTX-Spark Ready NVIDIA has partnered with Microsoft to ensure that developer tools are ready for RTX Spark. Alongside RTX Spark, the community is releasing: The first PyTorch-CUDA build for Windows on Arm. The first Python build that is native by default on Windows on Arm, with Python 3.15. The first native Conda installer for Windows on Arm, with over 2,000 Conda packages. 97% of the top 15,000 Python wheels are ready, thanks to work with the ecosystem. NVIDIA will be working closely with the community to ready the remaining wheels. Development is now mostly done by agents. NVIDIA Skills — an open source GitHub repository that teaches agents how to use NVIDIA CUDA-X tools and libraries — lets users develop apps that are accelerated on NVIDIA technologies, even without knowing anything about CUDA. Coding Agents Are Ready for Local AI In addition to GitHub Copilot — one of the most popular coding agents, used by millions worldwide — adding support for MXC, it’s updating its model router HydraFusion with support for local models. This enables developers to use their local hardware to reduce token consumption while tapping into frontier intelligence. Microsoft is making coding models, such as MAI 1.1 Coding Flash, available locally, and adding llama.cpp as a backend to Windows ML — extending the supported models and enabling the latest NVIDIA performance optimizations. Get started with GitHub Copilot running locally when RTX Spark launches. Llama.cpp Adds Support for Decision Models, Releases a Windows App Decision models are the latest breakthrough in AI development. They give AI agents a near-instant way to make decisions, without lengthy reasoning loops. They can choose what to do next, from classifying requests to selecting the next action, up to 200x faster than traditional agents. Decision models are now supported in llama.cpp and Unsloth on RTX Spark and GeForce RTX GPUs. Llama.cpp is also releasing today Llama Windows, a Windows-native companion app for llama.cpp, enabling an easy-to-use user interface to download and run models locally, without having to go into the command line. This app, like llama.cpp, is optimized for RTX Spark. Learn more on the Hugging Face blog. Llama Windows runs from the Windows 11 system tray, with local models and recommended models from the Hugging Face Hub one click away. Game On: RTX Spark Launches With Hundreds of Top Games and DLSS 5 RTX Spark is ready for gaming, with hundreds of top titles available when laptops launch on Friday, Oct. 16, including CONTROL Resonant, Cyberpunk 2077, Fortnite, Gears of War: E-Day, Genshin Impact, Hogwarts Legacy, Honkai: Star Rail, Marvel Rivals, NARAKA: BLADEPOINT, NBA 2K27, World of Warcraft and many more. NVIDIA has worked to bring the full stack of RTX technologies, including DLSS, Reflex, Remix, G-SYNC and ray tracing, to the new platform, along with collaborating with game developers to enable anti-cheat support for popular multiplayer games. Learn more about gaming on RTX Spark. DLSS 5 Brings Neural Rendering to RTX Spark NVIDIA DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering is also coming to RTX Spark on launch day. The technology uses AI to enhance lighting and materials with lifelike detail, making game worlds and characters more realistic while preserving developers’ artistic vision. A new, 2x faster DLSS 5 AI model debuts in NBA 2K27 on Friday, Oct. 16, boosting frame rates by up to 1.4x. The faster model will also power DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy starting Thursday, Nov. 5, and Where Winds Meet in late November. DLSS 5 is also coming to NVIDIA RTX Remix on Friday, Oct. 23, so modders can add better materials, lighting and shadows to classic characters and environments, as shown from modder Sparkles/Kim2091 in her in-development project, Fallout 4 RTX. Read more about DLSS 5 on RTX Spark on GeForce.com. Game Agents Running Locally on RTX Spark Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is the third-generation SLM for NVIDIA ACE, the suite of technologies for building in-game AI agents that deliver next-generation gaming experiences. The first-generation model was in a public beta earlier this year for PUBG, allowing players to team up with AI teammates, while the more efficient second-generation model previewed in Aniimo at Gamescom, turning standard creatures into voice-responsive companions. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B combines natural conversation with multi-turn tool use, instruction following and grounding in application state to power fast local voice and device assistants, interactive characters and embedded interfaces. Designed for a low memory footprint and fast time to first token, this model enables responsive local experiences while leaving headroom for applications and other AI models. Its new conversational mode helps keep responses concise and speech-ready, and developers can turn reasoning on or off as needed. Starting Friday, Oct. 23, test drive the third-generation Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB inside SkyrimNET, an AI nonplayable character (NPC) modding platform by MinLL for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. SkyrimNET transforms every NPC into an unscripted, interactive character equipped with personal memory, voice and autonomy for dynamic conversations and context-aware quests generated on the fly. Now compatible with RTX Spark, SkyrimNET supports both cloud and local inference across multiple models, with the latest Nemotron models delivering best-in-class performance for efficient and fast in-game interactions. Download the build on GitHub. Accelerating Modding Workflows in RTX Remix As AI agents continue to help modders make their favorite classic games compatible with the RTX Remix renderer, NVIDIA is streamlining asset updates with a major overhaul to its AI-powered texture generation workflow. Launching Friday, Oct. 23, as part of Remix 1.6, ComfyUI Version 2 replaces complex REST application programming interface (API) node connections with a dedicated AI tools layout directly in the sidebar. This update allows modders and artists to generate physically based rendering materials natively inside RTX Remix with zero API setup required. A new batch processing feature makes it easy to scale beyond single-texture experimentation to full modding projects, while an intuitive presets system lets non-technical creators adjust key settings without touching the node graph. items.content: Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application. France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork. The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments on French soil. What the ecosystem has built since then spans the full stack. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA’s Investments in France NVIDIA has been investing in France’s startup ecosystem, having previously invested in leading technology companies including Alice&Bob, Gradium and Scintil Photonics. Across all of Europe, NVIDIA has committed nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem. Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Doctolib, Entalpic, Genesis AI and Pigment. These startups are innovating to solve challenges across healthcare, materials discovery, physical AI and business planning. Doctolib, a European healthcare technology company, builds agents that free up healthcare professionals to deliver better care, while providing patients with a digital health companion that improves access to care and supports more preventive, continuous medicine. Entalpic, a Paris-based startup, accelerates the engineering of advanced materials at the atomic scale, with particular expertise in surfaces and interfaces for semiconductor manufacturing and next-generation electronics. Genesis AI is a global robotics company developing general-purpose robots with frontier intelligence and capabilities through its foundation models, data collection systems, simulation infrastructure and robot hardware. Pigment, a Paris-based enterprise software company, builds a planning platform that helps businesses forecast performance, model scenarios and make decisions across finance, sales, workforce and operations. Sovereign AI Infrastructure France-based companies are expanding agentic infrastructure on NVIDIA technology. Bull is extending its European AI server production to NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra NVL72 systems, planned for 2028, with trays produced in Europe and rack integration at its Angers factory — inaugurated Friday, Oct. 2. Altair-1, the first satellite in a $1 billion, 50-satellite constellation with on-board autonomous capabilities, launched this month and has successfully reached orbit. Integrated by Loft Orbital and built in Abu Dhabi by Orbitworks, a joint venture between Loft Orbital and Marlan Space, the satellite is flying NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin edge modules, running Mistral’s models, for real-time Earth observation and autonomous operations in orbit. Open Models NVIDIA Nemotron open models are in production across French organizations that require sovereign, trustworthy data. LINAGORA and Docaposte have secured the CANUT framework agreement, making Twake.ai, built on NVIDIA Nemotron, the sole referenced sovereign digital workplace for more than 2,500 French public organizations. In financial services, SBS is launching a sovereign platform enabling banks to deploy governed generative and agentic services within their own environments, in collaboration with NVIDIA. Last week, Mistral introduced under private preview Mistral Large 4 open model, with state-of-the-art, open weight performance in cyber defense, manufacturing, finance and multimodal tasks, and a solid foundation for customizing models across key industries. Fondation Inria, with NVIDIA’s support, is launching a working group on open source advanced modeling and tool adoption, with findings to come in the spring of next year. Agents at Work Across Industries Across retail, public services, telecommunications and science, the pattern is consistent: open models and NVIDIA infrastructure are driving results in France. L’Oréal is integrating NVIDIA ALCHEMI into its research workflows so scientists can explore formulation possibilities in silico and better help guide laboratory research. Combining computational predictions with hands-on experimentation can make the discovery process up to 100x faster than traditional methods and maximize the potential of the group’s proprietary active ingredients. Mirakl has onboarded more than 70 million products with fine-tuned and open models running on NVIDIA GPUs and inference software, cutting seller catalog onboarding to under two hours. Photoroom and Vestiaire Collective are demonstrating the measurable business impact of advanced visual modeling on marketplace performance. Omi helps brands bring accurate products into AI-generated marketing visuals at scale, combining its approved 3D digital twins with open models optimized on NVIDIA for 4x faster inference. In Côte-d’Or, ThinkDeep and Akila built a digital-twin agent — powered by NVIDIA Cosmos open world models, Nemotron and Omniverse libraries — managing nearly 5,800 kilometers of roads and buildings, cutting total operating costs by 10% and targeting 30% as deployment progresses. Port Sud de France runs goods processing and port security on ThinkDeep’s DeepBrain platform powered by Nemotron and Cosmos. Enchanted Tools, a robotics company headquartered in Paris, is deploying social robots to support patients in healthcare settings including pediatric cancer care. In telecom, Bouygues Telecom and Prisme.ai have launched AI Studio V2, powered by NVIDIA full-stack infrastructure, to offer all of its employees the ability to build their own agents, securely and in a controlled environment In quantum, Alice & Bob has integrated the NVIDIA NVQLink platform for its superconducting cat qubits, showing how GPUs can make quantum error correction more efficient, including for faster qubit modalities. Quandela has also been using NVQLink to build an integration between a DGX Spark system and its photonic qubits — advancing QPU-GPU supercomputing and exploring hybrid quantum-classical applications. Tune in to NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s GTC Berlin keynote on Wednesday, Oct. 21, at 11 a.m. CEST. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

items.titleZh: 英伟达宣布对法国初创企业进行新投资
items.descriptionZh:
法国AI生态正从“雄心”进入“规模化应用”阶段：法国企业正在航天、金融服务、公共部门和科研等行业部署代理式计算（agentic computing），背后是2025年2月AI Action Summit以及2025、2026年Choose France峰会所锚定的本土重大算力承诺。NVIDIA持续投资法国初创生态，此前已投资Alice&Bob、Gradium和Scintil Photonics；在整个欧洲，NVIDIA已承诺向技术生态投入近100亿美元。此次NVIDIA宣布计划投资Doctolib、Entalpic、Genesis AI和Pigment：Doctolib构建医疗代理，释放医护人员时间，并为患者提供数字健康伴侣，改善医疗可及性、支持预防和连续医疗；Entalpic在原子尺度加速先进材料工程，专长于半导体制造和新一代电子学的表面与界面；Genesis AI通过基础模型、数据采集系统、仿真基础设施和机器人硬件开发具前沿智能的通用机器人；Pigment构建企业规划平台，帮助企业在财务、销售、人力和运营中预测表现、建模情景并决策。

在主权AI基础设施方面，法国公司正基于NVIDIA技术扩展代理式基础设施。Bull将把欧洲AI服务器生产扩展到NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra NVL72系统，计划2028年推出，托盘在欧洲生产，机架集成在Angers工厂，该工厂于10月2日周五揭幕。Altair-1是10亿美元、50颗卫星星座的首颗，本月发射并成功入轨；由Loft Orbital集成，阿布扎比Orbitworks制造，后者是Loft Orbital与Marlan Space的合资企业。该卫星搭载NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin边缘模块，运行Mistral模型，用于实时地球观测和在轨自主操作。这意味着AI推理从地面延伸到卫星，降低对下行链路的依赖，并提升在轨自主性。

开放模型方面，NVIDIA Nemotron开放模型已在需要主权、可信数据的法国组织中生产使用。LINAGORA和Docaposte获得CANUT框架协议，使基于Nemotron构建的Twake.ai成为2500多家法国公共组织唯一被引用的主权数字工作场所。金融服务中，SBS与NVIDIA合作推出主权平台，让银行在自有环境中部署受治理的生成式和代理式服务。上周，Mistral推出私有预览的Mistral Large 4开放模型，在网络安全、制造、金融和多模态任务上达到开放权重的最先进性能，并可作为关键行业定制模型的基础。Fondation Inria在NVIDIA支持下启动开源高级建模和工具采用工作组，明年春季公布结果。

跨行业代理应用呈现一致模式：开放模型加NVIDIA基础设施在法国产生结果。L’Oréal将NVIDIA ALCHEMI整合进研究流程，让科学家在计算机中探索配方可能性并指导实验室研究；计算预测与实验结合可使发现过程比传统方法快至多100倍，最大化专有活性成分潜力。Mirakl用微调和开放模型在NVIDIA GPU及推理软件上上线超过7000万种产品，将卖家目录入驻时间降至两小时以内。Photoroom和Vestiaire Collective展示高级视觉建模对市场平台表现的商业影响。Omi结合经批准的3D数字孪生与在NVIDIA优化的开放模型，帮助品牌将准确产品规模化带入AI生成营销视觉，推理快4倍。在Côte-d’Or，ThinkDeep和Akila构建数字孪生代理，由NVIDIA Cosmos开放世界模型、Nemotron和Omniverse库驱动，管理近5800公里道路和建筑，总运营成本降低10%，并目标随部署推进达到30%。Port Sud de France在ThinkDeep的DeepBrain平台上运行货物处理和港口安全，由Nemotron和Cosmos驱动。巴黎机器人公司Enchanted Tools部署社交机器人，支持包括儿科癌症护理在内的医疗场景。电信领域，Bouygues Telecom和Prisme.ai推出AI Studio V2，基于NVIDIA全栈基础设施，让全体员工在安全受控环境中构建自己的代理。

量子计算方面，Alice & Bob将NVIDIA NVQLink平台集成到其超导猫量子比特中，展示GPU如何使量子纠错更高效，包括更快量子比特模式。Quandela也用NVQLink构建DGX Spark系统与其光子量子比特的集成，推进QPU-GPU超算并探索混合量子-经典应用。总体看，法国生态正从单点试验转向全栈代理式AI：主权算力、开放模型、边缘与在轨推理、数字孪生和量子加速共同构成应用基础。NVIDIA创始人兼CEO黄仁勋将于10月21日周三CEST上午11点在GTC Berlin发表主题演讲，更多NVIDIA欧洲公告可查阅相关页面。

items.descriptionZh:
佛罗里达大学、德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校和伦斯勒理工学院的研究人员发表技术论文《BARE-AI: Bit-Flip Attack Resilience in AI Hardware through Built-in Performance Monitors》，提出一种利用AI加速器内置性能监视器来检测比特翻转攻击（Bit-Flip Attack, BFA）的新框架。半导体工程（Semiconductor Engineering）以“片上监视器检测AI加速器中的比特翻转攻击”为题进行了报道。

背景方面，深度神经网络已广泛用于自动驾驶、医疗诊断、航空航天和工业控制等安全关键系统，但其硬件实现仍高度易受比特翻转攻击。攻击者可通过Rowhammer、电压/时钟毛刺、激光注入或恶意软件等方式，在存储器或寄存器中翻转一个或多个比特，篡改DNN权重、偏置、激活值或控制数据。即使单个关键比特出错，也可能导致模型误分类或功能失效。传统防护手段如ECC、冗余执行、校验和、权重加密等，往往带来面积、功耗和延迟开销，且可能无法覆盖所有故障模式，或难以区分自然错误与恶意攻击。

BARE-AI的核心思路是复用AI加速器中已有的内置性能监视器/硬件性能计数器，而非增加专用检测电路。这些监视器原本用于观测计算单元利用率、内存带宽、缓存命中率、停顿周期、DMA活动、功耗和温度等微架构事件。正常DNN推理会形成相对稳定的性能“指纹”；当比特翻转破坏权重或激活值后，数据依赖的执行路径、访存模式和计算负载会发生偏移，进而反映为性能指标异常。BARE-AI通过建立正常推理基线，在运行时持续监测这些指标，并用异常检测机制判断是否遭受BFA，必要时触发告警或恢复措施。

其创新点在于：以低开销、非侵入方式实现运行时BFA检测；复用现有片上监控基础设施，避免额外硬件成本；可覆盖ECC等传统方法可能遗漏的故障场景，并与ECC形成互补。公开摘要未披露具体检测率、误报率、检测延迟和性能开销数值，但此类评估通常会与传统ECC、冗余、校验和等方案对比，重点关注检测准确性、误报/漏报、响应时间和资源代价。

应用上，该技术有望提升边缘AI芯片、数据中心AI加速器、自动驾驶计算平台、医疗AI设备和航天电子系统的运行时安全性。挑战则包括：性能基线对工作负载和任务调度敏感，多租户环境可能引入干扰；某些不改变性能特征的静默比特翻转可能难以检测；攻击者也可能尝试规避监控。未来若与ECC、安全启动、模型完整性校验和冗余执行结合，可构建更完整的AI硬件安全防护体系。

history.titleZh: Agentic AI Automates RTL Waveform Analysis And Debugging (Columbia, Google)
history.descriptionZh:
哥伦比亚大学、Google DeepMind 与 Google 的研究人员联合发布技术论文《Back to the Future: Rethinking EDA Infrastructure for Agentic Systems in Chip Design Verification》，相关报道以“Agentic AI Automates RTL Waveform Analysis And Debugging”为题，介绍了该工作在芯片设计验证自动化方面的方向。该研究聚焦芯片验证中最耗时、最依赖人工的环节之一：RTL 波形分析与调试。

背景方面，现代人工智能的计算规模依赖包含数十亿晶体管的复杂 SoC，但验证这些芯片的工作流仍然“顽固地”以手动为主。验证工程师需要在仿真产生的大量波形中定位异常信号、回溯时序原因、构造测试并确认修复。尽管大语言模型在代码生成、自然语言理解和推理方面展现出能力，但传统 EDA 工具、数据格式和脚本接口并非为自主智能体设计，LLM 很难直接、可靠地嵌入验证闭环。因此，论文主张重新思考 EDA 基础设施，使其原生支持 agentic AI 系统。

核心技术方面，该研究提出或展示用 agentic AI 自动化 RTL 波形分析和调试。RTL 即寄存器传输级，是芯片逻辑设计的主要抽象层；仿真后生成的波形记录信号随时间变化，是调试功能错误和时序问题的关键证据。智能体系统可让 LLM 驱动多个工具和动作：读取波形与日志、理解信号语义、形成故障假设、调用 EDA 工具或脚本查询、运行定向仿真、缩小可疑范围，并给出根因或修复建议。其关键创新不是简单让 LLM 写代码，而是重构 EDA 基础设施，使工具具备机器可调用的 API、结构化状态、可组合动作和可观测反馈，从而支持“规划—执行—观察—反思”的自主调试循环。标题中的“Back to the Future”也暗示，这一思路可能借鉴早期 EDA 自动化或专家系统的目标，用现代 LLM 智能体重新实现。

性能与对比方面，从可见的论文摘要和报道片段看，尚未披露具体加速比、bug 定位准确率、波形压缩率或与人工调试的定量对比。但其预期优势明确：减少工程师在波形查看器中的手工搜索，缩短调试周期，提高验证吞吐，并让 LLM 从“辅助问答”升级为“执行验证任务”。与现有 LLM 辅助 RTL 代码生成相比，该工作更强调与 EDA 工具链深度集成和端到端任务自动化。

应用与影响方面，若该方法成熟，可用于 SoC、CPU、GPU、AI 加速器等复杂芯片的 RTL 回归测试、仿真波形调试、覆盖率收敛和 bug 根因分析。它还可能推动 EDA 工具设计范式从 GUI/脚本为中心转向 agent-ready，对 Synopsys、Cadence、Siemens EDA 等厂商及自研芯片团队均有启示。同时，幻觉、可解释性、安全性、数据隐私和与现有流程的兼容性仍是落地挑战。总体而言，这项工作代表 LLM/智能体进入芯片验证关键环节的重要方向：重点不只是模型能力，而是为智能体重建 EDA 基础设施，使 RTL 波形分析与调试真正自动化。

history.content: More AI agents will soon be able to browse and purchase from Shopify listings, marking an expansion of the company’s agentic commerce ambitions.Shopify announced Tuesday it will let shoppers configure their AI agents to purchase products on their behalf, giving more agents access to over a billion listings in Shopify’s catalog. (The catalog consists of both items on and off Shopify storefronts.) In September, Shopify announced it was partnering with Meta to allow its Muse agent to browse and purchase items on a human’s behalf; now, shoppers can use any agent without a partnership integration.To set up the feature, customers connect an agent with their account on Shop, a Shopify-owned platform that consolidates orders, tracks packages, and recommends products. Like the Muse partnership, customers use the one-click Shop Pay feature to check out within the conversation with the agent. Orders placed through the agent are funneled back to the Shop app. Shopify is marketing the feature as a “personal shopper” that humans can give rules to, like setting budget guardrails or only displaying products with fast shipping. Buyers must approve each purchase.E-commerce has become one of the battlegrounds in the era of AI — it’s no coincidence that many demos of agentic tools end with a transaction, whether it’s buying clothing, booking a flight, or ordering takeout on a human’s behalf. The tech industry, including big commerce players like Google and Amazon, are investing in AI-driven shopping tools where the end goal is an “agent” purchasing things for a human user. It’s also the basis of an ongoing fight between Amazon and AI companies like Perplexity — and more recently, Meta’s Muse — over whether agents should be able to shop on a customer’s behalf.

history.titleZh: Shopify向更多AI代理开放其商品目录
history.descriptionZh:
Shopify 周二宣布，将允许购物者配置自己的 AI 代理代其购买商品，使更多代理能够访问 Shopify 目录中超过 10 亿条商品列表。该目录包括在 Shopify 店面内和不在 Shopify 店面内的商品。这标志着 Shopify 代理式商务（agentic commerce）野心进一步扩大。此前在 9 月，Shopify 与 Meta 合作，允许 Meta 的 Muse 代理代表人类浏览和购买商品；现在，购物者可以使用任何代理，而无需 Shopify 与代理方进行合作集成。

在运作机制上，用户需要先把代理与自己的 Shop 账户连接。Shop 是 Shopify 拥有的平台，用于整合订单、跟踪包裹和推荐商品。与 Muse 合作时类似，顾客可在与代理的对话中使用一键 Shop Pay 结账。通过代理下的订单会回流到 Shop 应用。Shopify 将该功能营销为“个人购物者”，用户可以给它设定规则，例如预算护栏，或只显示配送快的商品。每笔购买必须由买家批准。

创新点主要在开放集成和基础设施复用，而非新的 AI 模型：Shopify 把代理接入其账户、支付和订单体系。此前代理购物需要专门合作，现在变成“任意代理 + Shop 账户 + Shop Pay + Shop 订单回流”的通用路径。这降低了代理购物的集成门槛，也让代理成为商品发现和交易入口。不过，原文未披露底层 API、身份验证、支付令牌化、安全审计等技术细节。

从对比数据看，原文给出的量化信息包括：覆盖 Shopify 目录超过 10 亿条商品；从仅支持 Meta Muse 扩展到支持任意代理；从需要合作集成变为无需合作集成。除此之外，没有提供响应延迟、支付成功率、购买转化率、支持代理数量、准确率等性能指标，因此无法进行更细的性能对比。

背景是，电商已成为 AI 时代的重要战场。许多代理工具演示最终都落在交易上，例如买衣服、订航班或替人点外卖。包括 Google、Amazon 在内的科技和商业巨头都在投资 AI 驱动购物工具，目标是让“代理”替用户购买。这也是 Amazon 与 Perplexity、以及近期 Meta 的 Muse 等 AI 公司持续争论的焦点：代理是否应被允许代表客户购物。

应用场景包括个人购物代理、预算受控消费、快速配送筛选、对话内结账和订单集中管理。对 Shopify 商家而言，可能获得来自代理的新流量；对消费者而言，便利性提升但需授权每笔购买。更广泛影响是，电商入口可能从人类浏览转向代理中介，平台需要重新处理代理身份、支付授权、订单归因和商家曝光，同时与 Amazon 等平台围绕代理能否代购的政策冲突也可能加剧。

history.content: After months sitting on the sidelines of the frontier AI race, Google has finally launched its long-awaited Gemini 4 Argon model, claiming it can compete with the best the industry has to offer.Google says Argon delivers “frontier reasoning and improved performance across complex workflows,” while cutting down on hedging, repetition, and the cliches that continue to plague AI chatbots. The company claims Argon outperforms rival models like GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5.5 across a range of benchmarks, including coding, cybersecurity, science, finance, and law.Google says it’s already putting Argon to use internally, such as finding and patching cybersecurity vulnerabilities, halving the computing power needed to power YouTube’s comments section, and debugging the drone physics simulator for Alphabet’s drone delivery company Wing.The model is rolling out today to Google’s higher-tier Pro and Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app and AI mode in Search, as well to Ultra subscribers on its agentic development platform Antigravity. It is not clear when — or if — Argon will be available to Plus subscribers or free users.Google is pricing Argon very competitively. The model is launching with an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, around a fifth the cost of OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and Anthropic’s Fable 5 models. Even after those costs double at the end November — when the introductory period finishes — Argon will still be significantly cheaper than its frontier rivals on a per-token basis, though this doesn’t necessarily translate to lower costs in practice, as models can use different numbers of tokens for the same tasks.The launch fills in some of the blanks left behind from when Google first teased Argon a few weeks ago. In line with other recent frontier model releases, the public rollout follows a limited release to a select set of “trusted cyber defenders” to be tested for potential risks.Argon is Google’s first major frontier release since Gemini 3 in late 2025. In the intervening months, impressive models from Anthropic and OpenAI have seen Google trail far behind its rivals. Seismic internal shakeups raised further doubts about the company’s ability — or desire — to reclaim its position and compete at the frontier of AI.But Argon’s arrival suggests we can’t count Google out of the AI race just yet. Landing just a day after Meta announced its own frontier model, Muse Wonder Full, Argon is a reminder of how quickly the balance of power can shift in AI, and that the frontier is far from a two-horse race.
history.author: Robert Hart
history.descriptionZh:
Google 在旁观前沿 AI 竞赛数月后，正式发布期待已久的 Gemini 4 Argon，并宣称其能够与业界最强模型竞争。Google 表示，Argon 提供“前沿推理”和“跨复杂工作流的性能改进”，同时减少 AI 聊天机器人常见的模棱两可/回避性表述、重复和套话。公司声称，Argon 在编码、网络安全、科学、金融和法律等一系列基准测试中，优于 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Opus 5.5 等竞品。不过，Google 并未披露 Argon 的具体架构、训练方法、上下文窗口、延迟、吞吐或各基准的具体得分，因此其“前沿推理”背后的技术机制尚不明确；公开可见的创新点主要集中在模型行为与输出质量优化，即降低 hedging、重复和陈词滥调，使复杂任务中的回答更直接、更可用。

从背景看，Argon 是 Google 自 2025 年末 Gemini 3 以来首个重大前沿模型发布。在这期间，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 推出了多款表现强劲的模型，Google 被认为明显落后于竞争对手；同时，公司内部剧烈震荡进一步引发外界对其能否或是否愿意重返前沿 AI 地位的怀疑。几周前，Google 首次预热 Argon，并遵循近期前沿模型发布的常见做法，先向一组“受信任的网络防御者”有限开放，以测试潜在风险。此次公开发布紧随 Meta 宣布其前沿模型 Muse Wonder Full 的一天后，显示 AI 领域的权力平衡可以迅速变化，前沿竞争也远非两强竞赛。

在性能和定价方面，Google 对 Argon 采取了极具竞争力的策略。该模型以介绍期价格推出：每百万输入 token 2 美元，每百万输出 token 10 美元，约为 OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 和 Anthropic Fable 5 模型的五分之一。即使 11 月底介绍期结束、价格翻倍，按每 token 计算，Argon 仍将显著低于这些前沿竞品。但需要注意，每 token 单价更低并不必然意味着实际任务总成本更低，因为不同模型完成同一任务时消耗的 token 数量可能不同。Google 目前也未提供与竞品对比的具体效率数据或基准分数，仅给出领先声明和内部用例。

可用性方面，Argon 今天起向 Google 更高阶的 Pro 和 Ultra 订阅者推出，覆盖 Gemini 应用和 Search 中的 AI 模式；同时也向智能体开发平台 Antigravity 的 Ultra 订阅者开放。目前尚不清楚 Argon 何时或是否会向 Plus 订阅者或免费用户提供。Google 表示，公司已在内部使用 Argon，包括发现并修补网络安全漏洞、将 YouTube 评论区的算力需求减半，以及为 Alphabet 旗下无人机配送公司 Wing 调试无人机物理模拟器。这些用例表明，Argon 的目标场景不仅是聊天，还包括网络安全、基础设施优化、科学/工程仿真和智能体开发。

总体而言，Argon 的发布填补了几周前预热留下的空白，并表明 Google 仍未退出前沿 AI 竞赛。它紧随 Meta 的发布，提醒业界前沿格局可能快速多极化，而非 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的双强游戏。对 Google 而言，Argon 是重新证明前沿竞争力的关键一步；对市场而言，其激进定价可能给竞争对手带来价格压力，并推动企业重新评估模型选型。但 Argon 的实际能力、可靠性和总拥有成本，仍需独立评测以及更广泛开放后进一步验证。

history.descriptionZh:
据《金融时报》报道，中国科技公司已购买超过 100 万颗 NVIDIA 游戏与工作站 GPU，用于填补 AI 算力需求缺口。这一采购潮发生在国产 AI 芯片产量快速扩张的背景下：中国将 AI 列为国家战略，推动本土 AI 芯片产量今年翻倍，但仍无法满足最大科技公司的需求。报道援引业内人士称，中国国内预计只能制造约 350 万颗 AI 芯片，而需求“远超”500 万颗，缺口接近 150 万颗。因此，中国企业转向符合美国出口管制的 NVIDIA 游戏和工作站处理器，并将其重新用于 AI 工作负载。

从技术路径看，这些芯片主要是 NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000D、RTX Pro 5000 和 RTX 5090，均属于 Blackwell 架构。它们无法与华为 Ascend 910C 等国产旗舰 AI 芯片正面竞争，但适合“较简单的 AI 工作负载”，例如推理中的预填充阶段。预填充是 LLM 推理的第一阶段：系统把用户输入的整段提示词并行编码，生成注意力 KV 缓存，计算密度高、并行度大，适合 GPU 吞吐；后续解码阶段逐 token 生成，更受显存带宽和延迟限制。消费级/工作站 GPU 虽缺少数据中心 GPU 的 HBM 高带宽内存和 NVLink/NVSwitch 高速互联，多卡扩展效率不如 H100/H200 等产品，但其 Tensor Core、GDDR 显存和 CUDA 生态仍能承担部分推理任务。尤其 CUDA 软件栈比华为 CANN 替代方案更成熟、开发者支持更广，这是中国企业继续采购 NVIDIA 硬件的重要原因。

性能与市场数据也凸显了供需失衡。RTX 5090 官方建议零售价为 1,999 美元，但目前只能在少数第三方经销商处找到，价格不低于 7,199 美元，溢价超过 260%，并且几乎从常规市场消失。报道还指出，NVIDIA 已停止 RTX 5090 生产，计划由 24GB 显存的 RTX 5080 旗舰型号取代；相比当前 32GB 显存的 RTX 5090，这是一次明显降级，对发烧友市场而言是消极信号，说明消费级 GPU 市场正被 AI 需求持续挤压。

这一现象的技术影响和产业含义是多方面的。首先，它表明美国出口管制虽然限制了中国获取最先进数据中心 GPU，但合规的游戏/工作站 GPU 仍可被重新部署到 AI 推理等场景，形成“合规硬件 + CUDA 生态”的算力补足策略。其次，国产 AI 芯片虽然产量翻倍，且华为 Ascend 910C 等产品在部分指标上具备竞争力，但软件生态、集群互联和开发者迁移成本仍是短板，导致中国大型科技公司仍严重依赖 NVIDIA 硬件。相关报道还显示，H200 已按逐案进口许可进入中国，但对 NVIDIA 而言可能为时已晚；同时，中国 AI 加速器供应商 Biren 营收同比增长 2000%，说明本土替代需求也在爆发。总体来看，中国 AI 算力市场正形成“国产芯片扩产 + 合规 NVIDIA GPU 补缺 + CUDA 生态锁定”的混合格局，而消费级 GPU 价格飙升和 RTX 5090 停产降级，则反映出 AI 算力争夺正在深刻重塑整个 GPU 市场。

history.title: Anthropic warns of self-replicating AI worm threat that doesn't need data centers to self-improve and spread
history.description: Anthropic’s paper establishes conceptual model capabilities, but doesn’t quite demonstrate a real threat until models improve further.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 12 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Anthropic's Frontier Red Team has demonstrated two components of a potential AI-powered worm that, if key issues with the practical implementation are resolved, could spread across consumer devices including inexpensive Android TV boxes and smart appliances, hypothetically without relying on datacenter infrastructure. The experiments show that AI agents can configure inference across different hardware platforms and orchestrate replication across a network. There are still some serious limitations, though, particularly around the gap between the capabilities of today's models versus the hardware constraints of potential targets.In its October 12 report, titled "AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter," Anthropic examines a potential class of malware called a weight-based replicator. Rather than distributing conventional executable code, it would propagate AI model weights alongside the software infrastructure needed to run inference on compromised devices, and it's not pure theory, either.The researchers demonstrated that Qwen3.5-9B can establish an inference server on eight of nine tested hardware types, spanning NVIDIA Jetson Nano devices, Apple Silicon Macs, Xeon servers, a Google TPU, AMD's MI300X, and at least one PC with an RTX 4090, among others. They also ran Gemma4-26B-A4B across 15 off-brand Android TV boxes costing approximately $55 each, achieving a combined generation rate of 0.39 tokens per second.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Anthropic also tested whether a model could orchestrate replication across a network. The experiment used eight Google Cloud nodes running Android 15 emulators. A seeded agent propagated between nodes through an unauthenticated Android Debug Bridge (ADB) port, transferring files and establishing an inference server on each target. GLM-5.2, a titanic model with 744 billion parameters over 1TB in size, completed the replication sequence across all eight nodes in four of five trials, reaching seven nodes in the remaining trial. (Image credit: Anthropic)No other tested open-weight model was able to complete the sequence at all without orchestration from GLM-5.2, and they weren't able to meaningfully ask a larger model for help, either, despite being equipped with the capability. Naturally, GLM-5.2 wasn't actually replicating itself onto smart TV boxes; instead, it established an inference server for the much smaller Llama 3.1 8B on each target. GLM-5.2 ran on a separate inference server because the emulated nodes couldn't handle the larger model. You may like Anthropic CEO warns of AI-driven botnet 'swarm' taking over the entire internet Anthropic claims popular Chinese AI model has Mythos-class hacking abilities AI leaders clash over safety fears after Anthropic whistleblower says AI could 'kill us all' by 2030 In other words, Anthropic demonstrated that a very large, externally hosted model can orchestrate a simplified replication sequence across machines with deliberately exposed ADB interfaces, and it showed that small models can set up inference, but it absolutely hasn't proven that a small model can independently replicate itself across consumer hardware. That distinction, admittedly fine, is nevertheless pretty important when the entire premise is that small models could soon spread without relying on datacenter infrastructure.The experiments expose a central constraint of the research: models capable of reliably completing the replication sequence aren't currently small enough to run on inexpensive target devices, while models that fit within those devices' memory budgets, despite being capable of setting up inference, still can't reliably complete the entire process. This gap between the intelligence needed for reliable replication and the maximum model size that target hardware can support means that this threat model isn't really applicable right now, but Anthropic warns that gap could narrow, and potentially soon.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors (Image credit: Anthropic)Using historical improvements in general AI capability (measured through the Epoch Capabilities Index), Anthropic projects that a model within the 30-billion-parameter class could reach the necessary capability level by the end of 2026. But once again, that's a hypothetical, and it still doesn't address the substantial efficiency problem.Based on measured inference performance and the token requirements of its setup experiments, Anthropic estimates that establishing an inference environment would take approximately 28–51 hours for Qwen3.5-9B and 71–150 hours for Gemma4-26B-A4B at the observed throughput of its cheap Android TV boxes, and it’s worth noting that the boxes it used are configurations with 4GB of RAM, a relative luxury among these cheap set-top boxes. A model-driven replicator could take days to establish an inference environment on a new host, whereas conventional malware can execute its payload within seconds when its assumptions about the target hold. A conventional worm can spread to tens of thousands of vulnerable targets in minutes.Model weights also impose substantial bandwidth and storage costs. Anthropic acknowledges that compromised hosts could download weights from external repositories rather than receiving them directly from an infected device, and that not every compromised machine would need to host a model. Nevertheless, distributing multi-gigabyte payloads and maintaining communication between machines running a sharded model would generate tremendous network traffic, making the activity very easy to detect. What to read next OpenAI's HuggingFace breach heralds an unprecedented age of AI cyber warfare OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and unreleased AI models break out of testing environment in 'unprecedented cybersecurity incident' Top AI labs reportedly planning for catastrophic AI event fallout Anthropic estimates that a hypothetical fleet comparable in size to the infamous Kimwolf botnet, which infected more than two million devices at its peak, could support approximately 133,000 instances of Gemma4-26B-A4B if every 15 devices collectively hosted one model. At the measured throughput (which benefits considerably from LAN latency), Anthropic says that such a fleet would provide roughly 40 Hopper H100-equivalents of inference capacity.This is a very messy comparison that takes significant liberties with the data, but even at that it must be said that it's not particularly intimidating. We're talking about two million infected devices that must remain infected and operable for months (or years; infecting 2 million devices would take around 6,300 agent-years even with the fastest 28-hour stand-up speed) to produce less AI inference throughput than a few blades of previous-generation GPUs.Anthropic notes that a real replicator could exploit other types of hardware, deploy different models across heterogeneous devices, and avoid loading model weights onto every compromised host. Those possibilities certainly complicate the comparison, but arguably they complicate it beyond the bounds of this discussion. (Image credit: Anthropic)The research does identify a meaningful security concern: AI agents could make malware more adaptable to unfamiliar environments and reduce the amount of target-specific engineering required. A hybrid approach, combining conventional code for routine operations with AI-driven reasoning when unexpected conditions arise, could offer some of those benefits without requiring every compromised device to run an inference engine continuously. This is definitely concerning, but we've already seen AI agents using frontier intelligence write their own code to compromise secured systems, so that specific angle on this research isn't exactly groundbreaking.Anthropic's experiments are useful in that they provide evidence that autonomous software configuration and simplified network replication are increasingly feasible, but turning those capabilities into a materially more dangerous class of malware will take improvements in model reliability, hardware compatibility, deployment efficiency, and the ability to overcome real-world security controls, which the firm didn’t test. There’s a ton of data and some interesting findings not discussed here in the actual paper, so if you’re interested in the research you should go check it out. history.titleZh: Anthropic警告：无需数据中心即可自我改进和传播的自我复制AI蠕虫威胁
history.descriptionZh:
Anthropic 的 Frontier Red Team 在 10 月 12 日发布的报告《AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter》中，演示了一种潜在 AI 驱动蠕虫的两个关键组件：跨异构硬件自动配置推理，以及跨网络编排复制。如果实际部署中的关键问题被解决，这类恶意软件理论上可绕过数据中心基础设施，在廉价 Android TV 盒子、智能家电等消费设备之间传播。但报告同时强调，当前实验仍存在严重限制，尤其是模型能力与目标硬件约束之间的巨大鸿沟。

报告提出了一类被称为“基于权重的复制器”（weight-based replicator）的恶意软件。它不传播传统可执行代码，而是把 AI 模型权重以及运行推理所需的软件基础设施一起传播到被感染设备上。这并非纯理论：研究人员让 Qwen3.5-9B 在 9 种测试硬件中的 8 种上成功建立推理服务器，覆盖 NVIDIA Jetson Nano、Apple Silicon Mac、Xeon 服务器、Google TPU、AMD MI300X，以及至少一台配备 RTX 4090 的 PC 等。他们还让 Gemma4-26B-A4B 在 15 台杂牌 Android TV 盒子上运行，这些盒子每台约 55 美元，合计生成速率仅为 0.39 tokens/s。

Anthropic 还测试了模型能否跨网络编排复制。实验使用 8 个运行 Android 15 模拟器的 Google Cloud 节点。一个“种子”智能体通过未认证的 Android 调试桥（ADB）端口在节点间传播，传输文件并在每个目标上建立推理服务器。拥有 7440 亿参数、体积超过 1TB 的巨型模型 GLM-5.2，在 5 次试验中有 4 次完成了全部 8 个节点的复制序列，剩余一次达到 7 个节点。其他被测开放权重模型如果没有 GLM-5.2 的编排，完全无法完成该序列，也无法有效向更大模型求助，尽管它们被赋予了这种能力。需要澄清的是，GLM-5.2 并未真正把自己复制到智能电视盒子上；它在每个目标上为小得多的 Llama 3.1 8B 建立推理服务器。GLM-5.2 本身运行在单独的推理服务器上，因为模拟节点无法承受这个大模型。

换言之，Anthropic 证明的是一个非常大的、外部托管的模型，可以在故意暴露 ADB 接口的机器之间编排简化的复制流程；也证明小模型可以建立推理环境。但它没有证明小模型能够独立地在消费级硬件上自我复制。这个区别看似微妙，却非常重要，因为整个威胁前提是“小模型可能很快在不依赖数据中心的情况下传播”。

实验暴露的核心矛盾是：能够可靠完成复制序列的模型，目前还不够小，无法在廉价目标设备上运行；而能塞进这些设备内存预算的模型，虽然可以建立推理，却仍无法可靠完成整个复制过程。可靠复制所需的智能水平与目标硬件支持的最大模型规模之间的差距，意味着这一威胁模型目前并不现实。但 Anthropic 警告，这一差距可能缩小，而且可能很快。基于 Epoch Capabilities Index 衡量的通用 AI 能力历史改进，Anthropic 预测 300 亿参数级别的模型可能在 2026 年底达到必要能力水平。但这仍是假设，且没有解决严重的效率问题。

根据实测推理性能和设置实验所需 token，Anthropic 估计，在廉价 Android TV 盒子的吞吐量下，Qwen3.5-9B 建立推理环境需要约 28–51 小时，Gemma4-26B-A4B 需要约 71–150 小时。值得注意的是，实验使用的盒子还是 4GB RAM 配置，在这类廉价机顶盒中已算相对奢侈。模型驱动的复制器可能需要数天才能在新主机上建立推理环境，而传统恶意软件在目标假设成立时可在数秒内执行载荷，传统蠕虫可在几分钟内传播到数万个脆弱目标。

模型权重还带来巨大的带宽和存储成本。Anthropic 承认，被感染主机可以从外部仓库下载权重，而不必直接从感染设备接收；也不是每台被感染机器都需要托管模型。然而，分发数 GB 级载荷，并维持运行分片模型的多台机器之间通信，会产生巨大网络流量，使活动非常容易被检测。

Anthropic 还估算，如果一支僵尸网络规模与臭名昭著的 Kimwolf 相当——后者峰值感染超过 200 万台设备——并且每 15 台设备集体托管一个模型，那么可支持约 133,000 个 Gemma4-26B-A4B 实例。按实测吞吐（显著受益于局域网延迟），这样一支舰队可提供约 40 个 Hopper H100 等效的推理容量。文章认为，这一比较非常粗糙，对数据做了很大自由发挥，但即便如此也谈不上特别可怕：200 万台被感染设备必须保持感染和可操作数月甚至数年，即使按最快的 28 小时部署速度，感染 200 万台也需要约 6,300 智能体年，最终产生的 AI 推理吞吐却少于几片上一代 GPU。

Anthropic 指出，真正的复制器可能利用其他类型硬件、在异构设备上部署不同模型，并避免把模型权重加载到每台被感染主机。这些可能性会让比较更复杂，但可能已超出讨论范围。研究确实识别出一个有意义的安全担忧：AI 智能体可使恶意软件更适应陌生环境，并减少针对特定目标所需的工程。混合方法——用常规代码处理日常操作，在意外条件出现时引入 AI 驱动推理——可能获得部分优势，而无需每台被感染设备持续运行推理引擎。这当然值得警惕，但此前已出现 AI 智能体利用前沿智能编写代码攻破安全系统，因此这一角度本身并非全新突破。

总体而言，Anthropic 的实验提供了有用证据：自主软件配置和简化网络复制正变得越来越可行。但要把这些能力转化为真正更危险的恶意软件，还需要在模型可靠性、硬件兼容性、部署效率以及克服现实世界安全控制方面取得改进，而这些是该公司并未测试的。论文中还有大量数据和有趣发现未在上述讨论中展开。当前威胁模型并不适用，但 Anthropic 警告，能力与硬件之间的差距可能收窄，安全界应持续关注。

history.content: When Nvidia originally showed off DLSS 5 earlier this year, the technology immediately got branded as gen AI for video games. To gamers, Nvidia had lost the plot. I personally couldn’t get over how faces were transformed using DLSS 5. The 15-year-old student from Hogwarts Legacy suddenly looked much older, and Grace from Resident Evil Requiem looked yassified.Now more than six months later, DLSS 5 is about to debut properly in Hogwarts Legacy, and it looks like it has been seriously toned down. Nvidia published new comparison screenshots today, where the changes to faces are as subtle as they are in NBA 2K27. Teenagers no longer look like middle-aged men, and even the environmental changes look more subtle.Nvidia’s DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy in March.Nvidia’s new Hogwarts Legacy DLSS 5 comparisons.Nvidia has always maintained that developers have “detailed artistic control” over DLSS 5, and ultimately make the choice on how to implement the technology in their own games. DLSS 5 will now appear in Hogwarts Legacy on November 5th, and it’s also coming to Where Winds Meet late next month.Nvidia is also improving the performance hit of DLSS 5 with an October update to the neural rendering system that should make it twice as fast on RTX 50-series GPUs and the upcoming RTX Spark laptops. “The DLSS 5 October update shrinks the footprint by 24 percent to roughly 118 million parameters while reducing 4K VRAM usage by 20 percent,” says Nvidia’s Andrew Burnes. This new DLSS 5 model will debut first in NBA 2K27 on October 16th and “will ship by default with future DLSS 5 games.”Alongside the DLSS 5 updates, Nvidia has also shipped a new Nvidia app beta update that includes a faster performance mode for Frame Generation on RTX 40- and 50-series GPUs. The updated AI model uses a “faster and lighter algorithm to boost frame rates” for Frame Gen, Multi Frame Gen, and Dynamic Multi Frame Gen. Nvidia says it has “minor trade-offs in image quality,” and that performance mode for Frame Generation should now be up to 35 precent faster.

history.titleZh: DLSS 5在《霍格沃茨之遗》下月首发中遭降级
history.descriptionZh:
今年早些时候英伟达首次展示DLSS 5时，该技术立即被贴上“游戏生成式AI”的标签，许多玩家认为英伟达偏离了方向。当时DLSS 5对面部的改变尤其引发争议：《霍格沃茨之遗》中15岁的学生看起来像中年男子，《生化危机：安魂曲》中的Grace则被过度美颜化。六个月后，DLSS 5即将在《霍格沃茨之遗》中正式上线，而效果已明显收敛。英伟达发布的新对比截图显示，面部变化已像NBA 2K27中那样微妙，青少年不再显老，环境变化也更加自然。英伟达一直强调，开发者对DLSS 5拥有“详细的艺术控制”，并最终决定如何在自家游戏中实现该技术。DLSS 5将于11月5日登陆《霍格沃茨之遗》，并将在下个月晚些时候登陆《燕云十六声》（Where Winds Meet）。

技术层面，DLSS 5是一套神经渲染系统。英伟达通过10月更新改善了其性能开销，使其在RTX 50系列GPU和即将推出的RTX Spark笔记本上速度提升一倍。英伟达的Andrew Burnes表示：“DLSS 5十月更新将模型占用缩小24%，降至约1.18亿参数，同时将4K分辨率下的显存使用减少20%。”这一新DLSS 5模型将于10月16日随NBA 2K27首次亮相，并“将默认随未来DLSS 5游戏发布”。这意味着更小、更高效的AI模型有望降低DLSS 5的硬件门槛和性能影响。

除DLSS 5更新外，英伟达还发布了新版Nvidia app测试版，为RTX 40和50系列GPU的帧生成引入更快的性能模式。更新后的AI模型采用“更快、更轻的算法来提升帧率”，覆盖Frame Gen、Multi Frame Gen和Dynamic Multi Frame Gen。英伟达承认该模式在图像质量上有“轻微妥协”，但帧生成的性能模式现在最高可提升35%。整体来看，英伟达正在通过模型压缩、算法优化和开发者控制，让生成式AI在游戏中的应用从最初争议性的“过度生成”转向更可控、更高效、更贴近艺术意图的实用阶段。

history.title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
