With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and […]
history.content: NVIDIA RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — a reinvention combining the capabilities of a gaming PC, a creative studio and a personal AI supercomputer into a single superchip. With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and CUDA technologies for creators, developers and gamers, while unlocking a new paradigm in personal computing via powerful local AI agents. Last week, NVIDIA and Microsoft announced that RTX Spark laptops will be available on Friday, Oct. 16. Ahead of the launch, NVIDIA and its ecosystem partners are rolling out new software features and performance optimizations to expand what’s possible with local AI on RTX Spark. New and upcoming RTX Spark updates — among the thousands of apps, games and models available at launch — include: New agent features, models and tools that enhance local agents on RTX Spark: Updates to top agent apps including GitHub Copilot, Hermes, OpenClaw, Perplexity, Pi and WorkBuddy streamline setup on RTX Spark, improve security with OpenShell and Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC), and enable hybrid local and cloud AI routing. The NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B model, purpose-built for agentic AI on RTX Spark, releases on Thursday, Oct. 15. NVIDIA PAIR moves out of beta and adds llama.cpp support. Top creative apps optimized for RTX Spark: Up to 2x performance is coming soon to Adobe’s top apps. NVIDIA and Adobe have collaborated to rearchitect Photoshop for GPU-accelerated compositing and Premiere for playback, rendering, effects and more. The NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 release brings new Video Super Resolution, Video Frame Generation, offline file processing and agent Model Context Protocol (MCP) controls to the app. NVIDIA RTX Video Frame Generation and high dynamic range (HDR) capabilities are available now in ComfyUI to accelerate AI generative video workflows. NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction will be available in Blender 5.3 in November to improve interactivity in the viewport. Developer tools are now ready for RTX Spark: Top developer frameworks are now available for RTX Spark, including PyTorch, Python and CUDA, as well as all CUDA libraries. GitHub Copilot, Pi and other coding agents are now optimized for RTX Spark. Llama.cpp adds support for decision models, and releases a Windows app. Hundreds of top games and anti-cheat are supported on RTX Spark, plus: A 2x faster DLSS 5 AI model arrives Friday, Oct. 16, and a new Performance Mode for DLSS Frame Generation is available today via the NVIDIA App beta. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, the third-generation small language model (SLM) for NVIDIA ACE AI game characters, releases Friday, Oct. 23. The latest RTX Remix update, including DLSS 5 support, releases on Friday, Oct. 23. Advancing Local AI Agents With New Apps, Models and Tools AI is changing the way people interact with PCs. Agent popularity skyrocketed this year, with projects such as OpenClaw and Hermes topping popularity charts on GitHub. Local large language models (LLMs) surpassed the intelligence threshold to power agents, with models like Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next catching up to frontier cloud models released just a few months ago. As a result, local LLM downloads are already 5x higher than all of last year. From models to agent harnesses to security to tools, NVIDIA is partnering closely with the local AI ecosystem to make RTX Spark the ideal hardware to run local agents. Local AI Agents Made Easy On RTX Spark From the first boot of RTX Spark, users will be greeted with a “Getting Started” screen to choose and install their agent app. These agents will come with new, secure sandboxing technology thanks to NVIDIA OpenShell and MXC. MXC delivers operating system-level security, while OpenShell makes it simpler for agents to adopt MXC and adds advanced capabilities such as credential protection and security monitoring. Hermes Agent will integrate granular OpenShell controls and MXC by the end of the month. OpenClaw and GitHub Copilot now support MXC. After installing an agent, setting up local AI is also now seamless in GitHub Copilot, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Perplexity, Pi and WorkBuddy. The apps will recommend an optimized local model and settings configuration for RTX Spark, and set it all up for users in a few clicks. Many users want the best of both worlds — local models for free iteration, and cloud models for frontier intelligence. NVIDIA Switchyard, an open source model router library, enables agents to intelligently route queries between local and cloud LLMs, allowing the user to minimize cloud usage but still obtain similar results to just running on cloud. Hermes will be adding Switchyard later in October, and other agents like Perplexity Computer and GitHub Copilot have integrated their own routing solutions. Software providers have made it simple for agents to connect to top Windows apps, with easy-to-use MCP libraries and command line interfaces (CLIs). NVIDIA has also now made available MCPs for its applications, including NVIDIA App, Broadcast, PAIR, Omniverse, RTX Remix and a large library of CUDA-X Skills. NVIDIA is also releasing AI playbooks for RTX Spark, available on Friday, Oct 16. Users can set up their first agent, build an AI chief of staff, configure their system for development or design a creative assistant. Meet Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B: Built for Local Agents on RTX Spark NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, available Thursday, Oct. 15, is a new LLM purpose-built for running local agents on RTX Spark. This model is a 74B parameter, 9B-active-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, packed into 24GB using 2-bit quantization with advanced quantization-aware training techniques to retain quality. It aims to achieve the optimal balance between speed and intelligence, being faster than most popular dense models while smarter than most popular MoE models with a similar memory footprint. Users will be able to run Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B at launch through llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, Unsloth and LM Studio. It will also be directly accessible via agents such as Hermes and OpenClaw. Like other Nemotron models, Bolt 74B is fully open source — including training data, weights and recipes — so developers can fine-tune and customize their own agents. The Perfect PAIR Local AI doesn’t have to run on just one PC. NVIDIA PAIR, a personal AI router, is officially moving out of beta today, making it easier to tap into the total AI compute of compatible PCs on a local network. The free, open source software tool automatically discovers and connects devices, installs AI models and inference engines, and distributes AI workloads across available systems. The official release adds llama.cpp support, direct model downloads from Hugging Face, customizable inference engine settings and RTX Spark support, along with a variety of inference and user experience improvements. PAIR works on Windows, Linux and macOS. Developers can contribute to the open source project via Github — just one month after the initial PAIR release, the community has already contributed over 10 features and fixes to the release. Sparking Creativity RTX Spark brings over 130 accelerated apps, CUDA for fast video and image generation, and RTX technologies such as DLSS, NVENC and OptiX to advanced content creation workflows — all in a thin and light laptop with on-the-go performance. Adobe Accelerates Creative Applications for RTX Spark Adobe is optimizing its industry-leading creative applications, including Photoshop, Premiere and Substance 3D, for RTX Spark, delivering up to 2x faster AI, editing, color and effects across creative workflows. In Photoshop, GPU-accelerated compositing makes complex image editing faster and more responsive, with improvements to the Remove Tool and effects such as Light Leaks. Premiere accelerates demanding video editing tasks, including playback, rendering, color grading and AI-powered features such as Enhance Speech and Object Mask. Meanwhile, Substance 3D Painter speeds up texture creation workflows, from baking high-resolution mesh maps to opening, saving and exporting large projects. The updates will be rolling out in phases, with AI feature optimizations in Photoshop and Premiere now ready in beta, and with Adobe Substance 3D updates coming soon. Opt in to the beta to get access to the RTX Spark-optimized builds. Latest NVIDIA Broadcast Brings New AI Effects to Live and Recorded Content Available for download now, NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 runs natively on RTX Spark, and adds new RTX Video Super Resolution and Frame Generation AI effects and Studio Voice profiles. A new Offline File Processor lets creators apply Broadcast effects to prerecorded content, with many effects running at higher quality since there isn’t a need to maintain real-time performance. The update also introduces a new MCP server and skill that lets local AI agents adjust effects, change settings and process files directly through the Broadcast app. RTX Video Brings Frame Generation and HDR to ComfyUI ComfyUI is expanding its RTX Video tools with two new nodes: RTX Video Frame Generation and RTX Video HDR. It’s also providing the ability to export EXR files, giving creators more ways to enhance AI-generated video. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/comfyui_nvidia_vfx_nodes_explainer_4k48_v4.mp4 RTX Video Frame Generation increases video frame rates for smoother motion for GeForce RTX 40 Series GPUs and newer, while RTX Video HDR converts standard dynamic range (SDR) footage to HDR for greater flexibility in color grading. Combined with RTX Video Super Resolution, these tools enable creators to upscale, enhance and refine video within a single ComfyUI workflow. For example, creators can combine LTX 2.5 with RTX Video Frame Generation and HDR to transform a 1080p, 30 frames-per-second (fps) SDR clip into a smoother 60 fps HDR video exported as EXR files ready for color grading. Blender Adds DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction Blender has released a beta version of its popular 3D editor, adding compatibility for RTX Spark. Download Blender version 5.3 to get access. Coming next month, Blender will also be adding support for DLSS Ray Reconstruction, allowing for real-time updates in the viewport so artists can navigate a scene while previewing it in real time. Code, Text and Deploy From RTX Spark Developers are moving from writing code to directing AI agents. This new development paradigm is requiring many to spread their work across their laptop, a cloud LLM and a cloud virtual machine, where they test and prototype. RTX Spark enables developers to work on one machine, running all their workloads and libraries, testing and prototyping, and deploying. They can now do so directly in Windows with the new Windows Developer Config, which enhances the user experience for devs and installs all the top developer tools — or via Windows Subsystem for Linux, where they can get access to the same packages they’ll use to publish to the cloud. Developer Tools Are RTX-Spark Ready NVIDIA has partnered with Microsoft to ensure that developer tools are ready for RTX Spark. Alongside RTX Spark, the community is releasing: The first PyTorch-CUDA build for Windows on Arm. The first Python build that is native by default on Windows on Arm, with Python 3.15. The first native Conda installer for Windows on Arm, with over 2,000 Conda packages. 97% of the top 15,000 Python wheels are ready, thanks to work with the ecosystem. NVIDIA will be working closely with the community to ready the remaining wheels. Development is now mostly done by agents. NVIDIA Skills — an open source GitHub repository that teaches agents how to use NVIDIA CUDA-X tools and libraries — lets users develop apps that are accelerated on NVIDIA technologies, even without knowing anything about CUDA. Coding Agents Are Ready for Local AI In addition to GitHub Copilot — one of the most popular coding agents, used by millions worldwide — adding support for MXC, it’s updating its model router HydraFusion with support for local models. This enables developers to use their local hardware to reduce token consumption while tapping into frontier intelligence. Microsoft is making coding models, such as MAI 1.1 Coding Flash, available locally, and adding llama.cpp as a backend to Windows ML — extending the supported models and enabling the latest NVIDIA performance optimizations. Get started with GitHub Copilot running locally when RTX Spark launches. Llama.cpp Adds Support for Decision Models, Releases a Windows App Decision models are the latest breakthrough in AI development. They give AI agents a near-instant way to make decisions, without lengthy reasoning loops. They can choose what to do next, from classifying requests to selecting the next action, up to 200x faster than traditional agents. Decision models are now supported in llama.cpp and Unsloth on RTX Spark and GeForce RTX GPUs. Llama.cpp is also releasing today Llama Windows, a Windows-native companion app for llama.cpp, enabling an easy-to-use user interface to download and run models locally, without having to go into the command line. This app, like llama.cpp, is optimized for RTX Spark. Learn more on the Hugging Face blog. Llama Windows runs from the Windows 11 system tray, with local models and recommended models from the Hugging Face Hub one click away. Game On: RTX Spark Launches With Hundreds of Top Games and DLSS 5 RTX Spark is ready for gaming, with hundreds of top titles available when laptops launch on Friday, Oct. 16, including CONTROL Resonant, Cyberpunk 2077, Fortnite, Gears of War: E-Day, Genshin Impact, Hogwarts Legacy, Honkai: Star Rail, Marvel Rivals, NARAKA: BLADEPOINT, NBA 2K27, World of Warcraft and many more. NVIDIA has worked to bring the full stack of RTX technologies, including DLSS, Reflex, Remix, G-SYNC and ray tracing, to the new platform, along with collaborating with game developers to enable anti-cheat support for popular multiplayer games. Learn more about gaming on RTX Spark. DLSS 5 Brings Neural Rendering to RTX Spark NVIDIA DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering is also coming to RTX Spark on launch day. The technology uses AI to enhance lighting and materials with lifelike detail, making game worlds and characters more realistic while preserving developers’ artistic vision. A new, 2x faster DLSS 5 AI model debuts in NBA 2K27 on Friday, Oct. 16, boosting frame rates by up to 1.4x. The faster model will also power DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy starting Thursday, Nov. 5, and Where Winds Meet in late November. DLSS 5 is also coming to NVIDIA RTX Remix on Friday, Oct. 23, so modders can add better materials, lighting and shadows to classic characters and environments, as shown from modder Sparkles/Kim2091 in her in-development project, Fallout 4 RTX. Read more about DLSS 5 on RTX Spark on GeForce.com. Game Agents Running Locally on RTX Spark Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is the third-generation SLM for NVIDIA ACE, the suite of technologies for building in-game AI agents that deliver next-generation gaming experiences. The first-generation model was in a public beta earlier this year for PUBG, allowing players to team up with AI teammates, while the more efficient second-generation model previewed in Aniimo at Gamescom, turning standard creatures into voice-responsive companions. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B combines natural conversation with multi-turn tool use, instruction following and grounding in application state to power fast local voice and device assistants, interactive characters and embedded interfaces. Designed for a low memory footprint and fast time to first token, this model enables responsive local experiences while leaving headroom for applications and other AI models. Its new conversational mode helps keep responses concise and speech-ready, and developers can turn reasoning on or off as needed. Starting Friday, Oct. 23, test drive the third-generation Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB inside SkyrimNET, an AI nonplayable character (NPC) modding platform by MinLL for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. SkyrimNET transforms every NPC into an unscripted, interactive character equipped with personal memory, voice and autonomy for dynamic conversations and context-aware quests generated on the fly. Now compatible with RTX Spark, SkyrimNET supports both cloud and local inference across multiple models, with the latest Nemotron models delivering best-in-class performance for efficient and fast in-game interactions. Download the build on GitHub. Accelerating Modding Workflows in RTX Remix As AI agents continue to help modders make their favorite classic games compatible with the RTX Remix renderer, NVIDIA is streamlining asset updates with a major overhaul to its AI-powered texture generation workflow. Launching Friday, Oct. 23, as part of Remix 1.6, ComfyUI Version 2 replaces complex REST application programming interface (API) node connections with a dedicated AI tools layout directly in the sidebar. This update allows modders and artists to generate physically based rendering materials natively inside RTX Remix with zero API setup required. A new batch processing feature makes it easy to scale beyond single-texture experimentation to full modding projects, while an intuitive presets system lets non-technical creators adjust key settings without touching the node graph. history.content: Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application. France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork. The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments on French soil. What the ecosystem has built since then spans the full stack. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA’s Investments in France NVIDIA has been investing in France’s startup ecosystem, having previously invested in leading technology companies including Alice&Bob, Gradium and Scintil Photonics. Across all of Europe, NVIDIA has committed nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem. Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Doctolib, Entalpic, Genesis AI and Pigment. These startups are innovating to solve challenges across healthcare, materials discovery, physical AI and business planning. Doctolib, a European healthcare technology company, builds agents that free up healthcare professionals to deliver better care, while providing patients with a digital health companion that improves access to care and supports more preventive, continuous medicine. Entalpic, a Paris-based startup, accelerates the engineering of advanced materials at the atomic scale, with particular expertise in surfaces and interfaces for semiconductor manufacturing and next-generation electronics. Genesis AI is a global robotics company developing general-purpose robots with frontier intelligence and capabilities through its foundation models, data collection systems, simulation infrastructure and robot hardware. Pigment, a Paris-based enterprise software company, builds a planning platform that helps businesses forecast performance, model scenarios and make decisions across finance, sales, workforce and operations. Sovereign AI Infrastructure France-based companies are expanding agentic infrastructure on NVIDIA technology. Bull is extending its European AI server production to NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra NVL72 systems, planned for 2028, with trays produced in Europe and rack integration at its Angers factory — inaugurated Friday, Oct. 2. Altair-1, the first satellite in a $1 billion, 50-satellite constellation with on-board autonomous capabilities, launched this month and has successfully reached orbit. Integrated by Loft Orbital and built in Abu Dhabi by Orbitworks, a joint venture between Loft Orbital and Marlan Space, the satellite is flying NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin edge modules, running Mistral’s models, for real-time Earth observation and autonomous operations in orbit. Open Models NVIDIA Nemotron open models are in production across French organizations that require sovereign, trustworthy data. LINAGORA and Docaposte have secured the CANUT framework agreement, making Twake.ai, built on NVIDIA Nemotron, the sole referenced sovereign digital workplace for more than 2,500 French public organizations. In financial services, SBS is launching a sovereign platform enabling banks to deploy governed generative and agentic services within their own environments, in collaboration with NVIDIA. Last week, Mistral introduced under private preview Mistral Large 4 open model, with state-of-the-art, open weight performance in cyber defense, manufacturing, finance and multimodal tasks, and a solid foundation for customizing models across key industries. Fondation Inria, with NVIDIA’s support, is launching a working group on open source advanced modeling and tool adoption, with findings to come in the spring of next year. Agents at Work Across Industries Across retail, public services, telecommunications and science, the pattern is consistent: open models and NVIDIA infrastructure are driving results in France. L’Oréal is integrating NVIDIA ALCHEMI into its research workflows so scientists can explore formulation possibilities in silico and better help guide laboratory research. Combining computational predictions with hands-on experimentation can make the discovery process up to 100x faster than traditional methods and maximize the potential of the group’s proprietary active ingredients. Mirakl has onboarded more than 70 million products with fine-tuned and open models running on NVIDIA GPUs and inference software, cutting seller catalog onboarding to under two hours. Photoroom and Vestiaire Collective are demonstrating the measurable business impact of advanced visual modeling on marketplace performance. Omi helps brands bring accurate products into AI-generated marketing visuals at scale, combining its approved 3D digital twins with open models optimized on NVIDIA for 4x faster inference. In Côte-d’Or, ThinkDeep and Akila built a digital-twin agent — powered by NVIDIA Cosmos open world models, Nemotron and Omniverse libraries — managing nearly 5,800 kilometers of roads and buildings, cutting total operating costs by 10% and targeting 30% as deployment progresses. Port Sud de France runs goods processing and port security on ThinkDeep’s DeepBrain platform powered by Nemotron and Cosmos. Enchanted Tools, a robotics company headquartered in Paris, is deploying social robots to support patients in healthcare settings including pediatric cancer care. In telecom, Bouygues Telecom and Prisme.ai have launched AI Studio V2, powered by NVIDIA full-stack infrastructure, to offer all of its employees the ability to build their own agents, securely and in a controlled environment In quantum, Alice & Bob has integrated the NVIDIA NVQLink platform for its superconducting cat qubits, showing how GPUs can make quantum error correction more efficient, including for faster qubit modalities. Quandela has also been using NVQLink to build an integration between a DGX Spark system and its photonic qubits — advancing QPU-GPU supercomputing and exploring hybrid quantum-classical applications. Tune in to NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s GTC Berlin keynote on Wednesday, Oct. 21, at 11 a.m. CEST. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

history.titleZh: 英伟达宣布对法国初创企业进行新投资
history.descriptionZh:
法国AI生态正从“雄心”进入“规模化应用”阶段：法国企业正在航天、金融服务、公共部门和科研等行业部署代理式计算（agentic computing），背后是2025年2月AI Action Summit以及2025、2026年Choose France峰会所锚定的本土重大算力承诺。NVIDIA持续投资法国初创生态，此前已投资Alice&Bob、Gradium和Scintil Photonics；在整个欧洲，NVIDIA已承诺向技术生态投入近100亿美元。此次NVIDIA宣布计划投资Doctolib、Entalpic、Genesis AI和Pigment：Doctolib构建医疗代理，释放医护人员时间，并为患者提供数字健康伴侣，改善医疗可及性、支持预防和连续医疗；Entalpic在原子尺度加速先进材料工程，专长于半导体制造和新一代电子学的表面与界面；Genesis AI通过基础模型、数据采集系统、仿真基础设施和机器人硬件开发具前沿智能的通用机器人；Pigment构建企业规划平台，帮助企业在财务、销售、人力和运营中预测表现、建模情景并决策。

在主权AI基础设施方面，法国公司正基于NVIDIA技术扩展代理式基础设施。Bull将把欧洲AI服务器生产扩展到NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra NVL72系统，计划2028年推出，托盘在欧洲生产，机架集成在Angers工厂，该工厂于10月2日周五揭幕。Altair-1是10亿美元、50颗卫星星座的首颗，本月发射并成功入轨；由Loft Orbital集成，阿布扎比Orbitworks制造，后者是Loft Orbital与Marlan Space的合资企业。该卫星搭载NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin边缘模块，运行Mistral模型，用于实时地球观测和在轨自主操作。这意味着AI推理从地面延伸到卫星，降低对下行链路的依赖，并提升在轨自主性。

开放模型方面，NVIDIA Nemotron开放模型已在需要主权、可信数据的法国组织中生产使用。LINAGORA和Docaposte获得CANUT框架协议，使基于Nemotron构建的Twake.ai成为2500多家法国公共组织唯一被引用的主权数字工作场所。金融服务中，SBS与NVIDIA合作推出主权平台，让银行在自有环境中部署受治理的生成式和代理式服务。上周，Mistral推出私有预览的Mistral Large 4开放模型，在网络安全、制造、金融和多模态任务上达到开放权重的最先进性能，并可作为关键行业定制模型的基础。Fondation Inria在NVIDIA支持下启动开源高级建模和工具采用工作组，明年春季公布结果。

跨行业代理应用呈现一致模式：开放模型加NVIDIA基础设施在法国产生结果。L’Oréal将NVIDIA ALCHEMI整合进研究流程，让科学家在计算机中探索配方可能性并指导实验室研究；计算预测与实验结合可使发现过程比传统方法快至多100倍，最大化专有活性成分潜力。Mirakl用微调和开放模型在NVIDIA GPU及推理软件上上线超过7000万种产品，将卖家目录入驻时间降至两小时以内。Photoroom和Vestiaire Collective展示高级视觉建模对市场平台表现的商业影响。Omi结合经批准的3D数字孪生与在NVIDIA优化的开放模型，帮助品牌将准确产品规模化带入AI生成营销视觉，推理快4倍。在Côte-d’Or，ThinkDeep和Akila构建数字孪生代理，由NVIDIA Cosmos开放世界模型、Nemotron和Omniverse库驱动，管理近5800公里道路和建筑，总运营成本降低10%，并目标随部署推进达到30%。Port Sud de France在ThinkDeep的DeepBrain平台上运行货物处理和港口安全，由Nemotron和Cosmos驱动。巴黎机器人公司Enchanted Tools部署社交机器人，支持包括儿科癌症护理在内的医疗场景。电信领域，Bouygues Telecom和Prisme.ai推出AI Studio V2，基于NVIDIA全栈基础设施，让全体员工在安全受控环境中构建自己的代理。

量子计算方面，Alice & Bob将NVIDIA NVQLink平台集成到其超导猫量子比特中，展示GPU如何使量子纠错更高效，包括更快量子比特模式。Quandela也用NVQLink构建DGX Spark系统与其光子量子比特的集成，推进QPU-GPU超算并探索混合量子-经典应用。总体看，法国生态正从单点试验转向全栈代理式AI：主权算力、开放模型、边缘与在轨推理、数字孪生和量子加速共同构成应用基础。NVIDIA创始人兼CEO黄仁勋将于10月21日周三CEST上午11点在GTC Berlin发表主题演讲，更多NVIDIA欧洲公告可查阅相关页面。

history.descriptionZh:
佛罗里达大学、德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校和伦斯勒理工学院的研究人员发表技术论文《BARE-AI: Bit-Flip Attack Resilience in AI Hardware through Built-in Performance Monitors》，提出一种利用AI加速器内置性能监视器来检测比特翻转攻击（Bit-Flip Attack, BFA）的新框架。半导体工程（Semiconductor Engineering）以“片上监视器检测AI加速器中的比特翻转攻击”为题进行了报道。

背景方面，深度神经网络已广泛用于自动驾驶、医疗诊断、航空航天和工业控制等安全关键系统，但其硬件实现仍高度易受比特翻转攻击。攻击者可通过Rowhammer、电压/时钟毛刺、激光注入或恶意软件等方式，在存储器或寄存器中翻转一个或多个比特，篡改DNN权重、偏置、激活值或控制数据。即使单个关键比特出错，也可能导致模型误分类或功能失效。传统防护手段如ECC、冗余执行、校验和、权重加密等，往往带来面积、功耗和延迟开销，且可能无法覆盖所有故障模式，或难以区分自然错误与恶意攻击。

BARE-AI的核心思路是复用AI加速器中已有的内置性能监视器/硬件性能计数器，而非增加专用检测电路。这些监视器原本用于观测计算单元利用率、内存带宽、缓存命中率、停顿周期、DMA活动、功耗和温度等微架构事件。正常DNN推理会形成相对稳定的性能“指纹”；当比特翻转破坏权重或激活值后，数据依赖的执行路径、访存模式和计算负载会发生偏移，进而反映为性能指标异常。BARE-AI通过建立正常推理基线，在运行时持续监测这些指标，并用异常检测机制判断是否遭受BFA，必要时触发告警或恢复措施。

其创新点在于：以低开销、非侵入方式实现运行时BFA检测；复用现有片上监控基础设施，避免额外硬件成本；可覆盖ECC等传统方法可能遗漏的故障场景，并与ECC形成互补。公开摘要未披露具体检测率、误报率、检测延迟和性能开销数值，但此类评估通常会与传统ECC、冗余、校验和等方案对比，重点关注检测准确性、误报/漏报、响应时间和资源代价。

应用上，该技术有望提升边缘AI芯片、数据中心AI加速器、自动驾驶计算平台、医疗AI设备和航天电子系统的运行时安全性。挑战则包括：性能基线对工作负载和任务调度敏感，多租户环境可能引入干扰；某些不改变性能特征的静默比特翻转可能难以检测；攻击者也可能尝试规避监控。未来若与ECC、安全启动、模型完整性校验和冗余执行结合，可构建更完整的AI硬件安全防护体系。
